napuṃsakam parityajya kuryāt tat veda bhājitam
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘sādhyanāmākṣaraṃ’ sādhyanāmavarṇān / ‘sādhakāhvayavarṇataḥ’ sādhakanāmākṣarebhyaḥ / ‘gaṇyaṃ’ gaṇayet / kiṃ kṛtvā? ‘napuṃsakaṃ parityajya’ ṛ ṝ ḷ ḹ iti napuṃsakāni parityajya / ‘tad vedabhājitaṃ’ tat––sādhyasādhakayor anusvāravyañjanagaṇyamānarāśiṃ vedabhājitaṃ––caturbhājitaṃ kuryāt // 2.15 //
analyzed: sādhya nāma akṣaram sādhya nāma varṇān sādhaka āhvaya varṇataḥ sādhaka nāma akṣarebhyaḥ gaṇyam gaṇayet kim kṛtvā napuṃsakam parityajya ṛ ṝ ḷ ḷ iti napuṃsakāni parityajya tat veda bhājitam tad sādhya sādhakayoḥ anusvāra vyañjana gaṇyamāna rāśim veda bhājitam catur bhājitam kuryāt

original: āyo bhāgoddharitaṃ taṃ cādyaṃ sthāpayet kramād dhīmān |
analyzed: āyaḥ bhāga uddharitam tam ca ādyam sthāpayet kramāt dhīmān
eka dvi tri catur varṇān siddham sādhyam susiddham ariḥ
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘āyo bhāgoddharitaṃ’ prakṛtasādhyasādhakarāśau caturbhir bhāge hṛte yad uddharitaṃ sa āyaḥ / ‘taṃ ca’ uddharitaṃ āyaṃ ca / ‘ādyaṃ sthāpayet’ viśleṣitasādhyamātrānusvāravyañjanapaṅktau ādau sthāpayet / katham? ‘kramāt’ paṅktau yathānukrameṇa / kaḥ? dhīmān /
analyzed: āyaḥ bhāga uddharitam prakṛta sādhya sādhaka rāśau caturbhiḥ bhāge hṛte yat uddharitam saḥ āyaḥ tam ca uddharitam āyam ca ādyam sthāpayet viśleṣita sādhya mātra anusvāra vyañjana paṅktau ādau sthāpayet katham kramāt paṅktau yathā anukrameṇa kaḥ dhīmān

original: ‘ekadvitricaturvarṇān siddhaṃ sādhyaṃ susiddhaṃ ariḥ’ eka uddharite siddhaṃ, dvir uddharite sādhyaṃ, trir uddharite susiddham, catur uddharite śatruḥ ity evaṃ jñātavyam // 2.16 //
analyzed: eka dvi tri catur varṇān siddham sādhyam su siddham ariḥ eke uddharite siddham dvis uddharite sādhyam tris uddharite su siddham catuḥ uddharite śatruḥ iti evam jñātavyam 216

original: siddhasusiddhaṃ grāhyaṃ sādhyaṃ śatruṃ ca varjayed dhīmān |
analyzed: siddha susiddham grāhyam sādhyam śatrum ca varjayet dhīmān

original: siddhasusiddhe phalade viphalaṃ sādhye ripau vāye || 2.17 ||
analyzed: siddha susiddhe phala de viphalam sādhye ripau vāye
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘siddhasusiddhaṃ grāhyaṃ’ caturāyamadhye siddhasusiddham ity āyadvayaṃ grāhyam / ‘sādhyaṃ śatruṃ ca varjayet’ tadāyamadhye sādhyaṃ śatruṃ ca ity āyadvayaṃ varjayet / kaḥ? ‘dhīmān’ buddhimān / ‘siddhasusiddhaṃ phalade’ siddhasusiddham ityāyadvaye saphale mantrasya phalaṃ bhavati /
analyzed: siddha susiddham grāhyam catur āya madhye siddha susiddham iti āya dvayam grāhyam sādhyam śatrum ca varjayet tad āya madhye sādhyam śatrum ca iti āya dvayam varjayet kaḥ dhīmān buddhimān siddha susiddham phala de siddha susiddham iti āya dvaye saphale mantrasya phalam bhavati

original: ‘viphalaṃ sādhye ripau vāye’ sādhye ripau vā āyadvaye mantraṃ viphalaṃ syāt // 2.17 //
analyzed: viphalam sādhye ripau vāye sādhye ripau vā āya dvaye mantram viphalam syāt

original: phaladaṃ katipayadivasaiḥ siddhaṃ cet sādhyam api dinair bahubhiḥ |
analyzed: phala dam katipaya divasaiḥ siddham ced sādhyam api dinaiḥ bahubhiḥ
jhaṭiti phala dam su siddham prāṇa artha vināśanaḥ śatruḥ

Vivaraṇa

original: ‘siddhaṃ cet’ siddhaṃ mantraṃ cet / ‘katipayadivasaiḥ’ kiyadbhirvāsaraiḥ / ‘phaladaṃ’ phaladāyakaṃ bhavati / ‘sādhyam api dinair bahubhiḥ’ api––paścāt sādhyaṃ mantraṃ bahubhir dinaiḥ phaladaṃ bhavati / ‘jhaṭiti phaladaṃ susiddhaṃ’ susiddhaṃ mantraṃ jhaṭiti śīghraṃ phaladāyakaṃ bhavati /
analyzed: siddham ced siddham mantram ced katipaya divasaiḥ kiyadbhiḥ vāsaraiḥ phala dam phala dāyakam bhavati sādhyam api dinaiḥ bahubhiḥ api paścāt sādhyam mantram bahubhiḥ dinaiḥ phala dam bhavati jhaṭiti phala dam su siddham su siddham mantram jhaṭiti śīghram phala dāyakam bhavati
prāṇa artha vināśanaḥ śatruḥ śatruḥ mantram prāṇa artha vināśa karaḥ bhavati 218

original: ādāv ante śatrur yadi bhavati tadā parityajen mantram |
analyzed: ādau ante śatruḥ yadi bhavati tadā parityajet mantram

original: sthānatritaye śatrur mṛtyuḥ syāt kāryahānir vā || 2.19 ||
analyzed: sthāna tritaye śatruḥ mṛtyuḥ syāt kārya hāniḥ vā
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘ādāv ante śatrur yadi bhavati’ mantrasyādau mantrānte yadi śatrur bhavati ‘tadā parityajen mantram’ mantraṃ parivarjayet / ‘sthānatritaye śatrur mṛtyuḥ syāt’ ādimadhyāvasāne yadi śatrur bhavati mantrasya tadā mṛtyur bhavati ‘kāryahānir vā’ kāryanāśo vā bhavati // 2.19 //
analyzed: ādau ante śatruḥ yadi bhavati mantrasya ādau mantra ante yadi śatruḥ bhavati tadā parityajet mantram mantram parivarjayet sthāna tritaye śatruḥ mṛtyuḥ syāt ādi madhya avasāne yadi śatruḥ bhavati mantrasya tadā mṛtyuḥ bhavati kārya hāniḥ vā kārya nāśaḥ vā bhavati

original: śatrūr bhavati yadādau madhye siddhaṃ tadantagaṃ sādhyam |
analyzed: śatrūḥ bhavati yat ādau madhye siddham tad anta gam sādhyam

original: kaṣṭena bhavati mahatā svalpaphalaṃ ceti kathanīyam || 2.20 ||
analyzed: kaṣṭena bhavati mahatā su alpa phalam ca iti kathanīyam
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘śatruḥ’ ityādi / yadā āyagaṇane prathamataḥ śatrur bhavati, mantrasya madhye siddhaṃ bhavati / ‘tadantagaṃ sādhyaṃ’ mantrasyāntagaṃ sādhyaṃ cet / ‘kaṣṭena bhavati mahatā’ mahatā––atyantakleśena jāyate svalpaphalam / caḥ samuccaye / ‘iti’ anena prakāreṇa kathanīyam // 2.20 //
analyzed: śatruḥ ityādi yadā āya gaṇane prathamatas śatruḥ bhavati mantrasya madhye siddham bhavati tad anta gam sādhyam mantrasya anta gam sādhyam ced kaṣṭena bhavati mahatā mahatā atyanta kleśena jāyate svalpa phalam caḥ samuccaye iti anena prakāreṇa kathanīyam

original: ante yadi bhavati ripuḥ prathame madhye ca siddhayugapatanam |
analyzed: ante yadi bhavati ripuḥ prathame madhye ca siddha yuga patanam

original: kāryaṃ yadādijātaṃ tan naśyati sarvam evānte || 2.21 ||
analyzed: kāryam yat ādi jātam tat naśyati sarvam eva ante
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘ante yadi bhavati ripuḥ’ mantrasyānte yadi śatrur bhavati / ‘prathame madhye ca siddhayugapatanam’ mantrādau mantramadhye ca siddhayugmapāto yadi bhavati / ‘kāryaṃ yadādijātaṃ’ evaṃvidhamantre yat pūrvaṃ jātaṃ kāryaṃ amitaphalaṃ ‘tan naśyati sarvam evānte’ tat––kāryaṃ janitaphalaṃ sarvam evānte––avasāne nāśaṃ prāpnoti // 2.21 //
analyzed: ante yadi bhavati ripuḥ mantrasya ante yadi śatruḥ bhavati prathame madhye ca siddha yuga patanam mantra ādau mantra madhye ca siddha yugma pātaḥ yadi bhavati kāryam yad ādi jātam evaṃvidha mantre yat pūrvam jātam kāryam amita phalam tat naśyati sarvam eva ante tat kāryam janita phalam sarvam eva ante avasāne nāśam prāpnoti

original: siddhaṃ susiddham athavā ripuṇāntaritaṃ nirīkṣyate yatra |
analyzed: siddham su siddham athavā ripuṇā antaritam nirīkṣyate yatra
duḥkha apāya prabalam bhavati iti vivarjayet kāryam
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘athavā’ anyaprakāreṇa / ‘siddhaṃ’ siddhapadaṃ / susiddhaṃ susiddhapadam / ‘ripuṇāntaritaṃ’ śatrupadāntaritaṃ yadi ‘nirīkṣyate yatra’ yasmin mantre nirīkṣyate––dṛśyate tadā ‘duḥkhāpāyaprabalaṃ’ kleśānarthapracuraṃ bhavati ‘iti’ evaṃ jñātvā ‘vivarjayen mantraṃ’ sādhanakāryaṃ parivarjayet // 2.22 //
analyzed: athavā anya prakāreṇa siddham siddha padam su siddham su siddha padam ripuṇā antaritam śatru pada antaritam yadi nirīkṣyate yatra yasmin mantre tadā duḥkha apāya prabalam kleśa anartha pracuram bhavati iti evam jñātvā vivarjayet mantram sādhana kāryam parivarjayet

original: ity ubhayabhāṣākaviśekharaśrīmalliṣeṇasūriviracite bhairavapadmāvatīkalpe sakalīkaraṇaṃ nāma dvitīyaḥ paricchedaḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: iti ubhaya bhāṣā kavi śekhara śrī malliṣeṇa sūri viracite bhairavapadmāvatīkalpe sakalīkaraṇam nāma dvitīyaḥ paricchedaḥ 2

original: ‘dīpana’ dīpanena śāntikaṃ kuryāt, ‘pallava’ pallavena vidveṣaṇaṃ kuryāt, ‘sampuṭa’ sampuṭena vaśyaṃ kuryāt, ‘rodhana’ rodhanena bandhaṃ kuryāt, ‘grathanā’ grathanayā stryākṛṣṭiṃ kuryāt, ‘vidarbhaṇa’ vidarbhaṇena krodhādistambhaṃ kuryāt // 3.1 //

atha dīpana ādīnām vyākhyā

original: ādau nāmaniveśo dīpanam ante ca pallavo jñeyaḥ |
analyzed: ādau nāma niveśaḥ dīpanam ante ca pallavaḥ jñeyaḥ

grathanam varga antaritam dvi akṣara madhya sthitaḥ vidarbhaḥ syāt
ṣaṭkarma karaṇam etat jñātvā anuṣṭhānam ācaret mantrī

original: ‘ādau nāmaniveśau dīpanam’ mantrasyādau yannāmaniveśanaṃ taddīpanaṃ syāt / ‘ante ca pallavo jñeyaḥ’ mantrasyānte yannāmaniveśanaṃ sa pallavo ‘jñeyaḥ’ jñātavyaḥ / ‘tanmadhyagataṃ sampuṭaṃ’ tanmantramadhye niveśitaṃ nāmasampuṭam iti syāt / ‘athādimadhyāntago rodhaḥ’ atha ––paścāt mantrasyādau madhye ante ca yannāmaniveśanaṃ sa rodhaḥ syāt /
analyzed: ādau nāma niveśau dīpanam mantrasya ādau yat nāma niveśanam tat dīpanam syāt ante ca pallavaḥ jñeyaḥ mantrasya ante yat nāma niveśanam sa pallavaḥ jñeyaḥ jñātavyaḥ tad madhya gatam sampuṭam tat mantra madhye niveśitam nāma sampuṭam iti syāt atha ādi madhya anta gaḥ rodhaḥ atha paścāt mantrasya ādau madhye ante ca yat nāma niveśanam sa rodhaḥ syāt

original: ‘grathanaṃ varṇāntaritam’ mantrasyākṣaram ekaṃ nāmākṣaram ekaṃ evaṃ varṇagrathanaṃ tad grathanam iti syāt / ‘dvyakṣaramadhyasthito vidarbhaḥ syāt’ mantrasyākṣaradvaya prati paścād yannāmaniveśaḥ sa vidarbhaḥ syāt / ‘ṣaṭkarṃakaraṇam etat’, etac chāntyādiṣaṭkarmakriyāvidhānaṃ ‘jñātvā’ buddhvā anuṣṭhānaṃ mantravādī ācaret // 3.2–3 //
analyzed: grathanam varṇa antaritam mantrasya akṣaram ekam nāma akṣaram ekam evam varṇa grathanam tat grathanam iti syāt dvi akṣara madhya sthitaḥ vidarbhaḥ syāt mantrasya akṣara dvaya prati paścāt yat nāma niveśaḥ sa vidarbhaḥ syāt etat etat śānti ādi ṣaṭkarma kriyā vidhānam jñātvā buddhvā anuṣṭhānam mantra vādī ācaret

original: dikkālamudrāsanapallavānāṃ bhedaṃ parijñāya japet sa mantrī |
analyzed: diś kāla mudrā āsana pallavānām bhedam parijñāya japet sa mantrī

analyzed: na ca anyathā sidhyati tasya mantram kurvan sadā tiṣṭhatu jāpya homam
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘dikkāla-’ ityādi / dik ca kālaś ca mudrā ca āsanaṃ ca pallavaś ca dikkālamudrāsanapallavāḥ teṣāṃ dikkālamudrāsanapallavānāṃ, ‘bhedaṃ’ vivaraṇaṃ, ‘parijñāya’ samyag jñātvā, saḥ ‘mantrī’ mantravādī japet ‘jāpaṃ’ kuryāt /
analyzed: diś kālaḥ ityādi diś ca kālaḥ ca mudrā ca āsanam ca pallavaḥ ca diś kāla mudrā āsana pallavāḥ teṣām diś kāla mudrā āsana pallavānām bhedam vivaraṇam parijñāya samyak jñātvā saḥ mantrī mantra vādī japet jāpam kuryāt

original: ‘na cānyathā sidhyati tasya mantram’ anyathā –– dikkālādibhedaparijñānābhāve tasya –– mantriṇaḥ mantra ‘na sidhyati’ siddhiṃ na prāpnoti / ‘kurvan sadā tiṣṭhatu jāpyahomaṃ’ jāpyahomaṃ kurvan san sadā tiṣṭhatu paraṃ na sidhyati // 3.4 //
analyzed: na ca anyathā sidhyati tasya mantram anyathā diś kāla ādi bheda parijñāna abhāve tasya mantriṇaḥ na sidhyati siddhim na prāpnoti kurvan sadā tiṣṭhatu jāpya homam jāpya homam kurvan san sadā tiṣṭhatu param na sidhyati

original: ‘vaśyākṛṣṭistambhananiṣedhavidveṣacalanaśāntikaṃ puṣṭim’ etāni karmāṇi / ‘somayamāmaraharāgnimarudabdhinirṛtidigvadanaḥ’ / ‘soma’ uttarābhimukhena vaśyakarma / ‘yama’ dakṣiṇābhimukhena ‘ākṛṣṭiḥ’ ākarṣaṇakarma / ‘amara’ pūrvābhimukhena stambhanakarma / ‘hara’ īśānābhimukhena niṣedhakarma / ‘agni’ agnidiṅmukhena vidveṣaṇakarma /
analyzed: vaśyā ākṛṣṭi stambhana niṣedha vidveṣa calana śāntikam puṣṭim etāni karmāṇi soma yama amara hara agni marut abdhi nirṛti diś vadanaḥ soma uttara abhimukhena vaśya karma yama dakṣiṇa abhimukhena ākṛṣṭiḥ ākarṣaṇa karma amara pūrva abhimukhena stambhana karma hara īśāna abhimukhena niṣedha karma agni agni diś mukhena vidveṣaṇa karma

original: ‘marut’ vāyavyadiṅmukhena ‘calana’ uccāṭanakarma / ‘abdhi’ paścimābhimukhena ‘śāntikaṃ’ śāntikarma / ‘nairṛtidigvadanaḥ’ nairṛtyābhimukhena pauṣṭikakarma / iti digvadano bhūtvā vaśyādikarmāṇi kuryāt // 3.5 //
analyzed: marut vāyavya diś mukhena calanaḥ uccāṭana karma abdhi paścima abhimukhena śāntikam śānti karma nairṛti diś vadanaḥ nairṛtya abhimukhena pauṣṭika karma iti diś vadanaḥ bhūtvā vaśyā ādi karmāṇi kuryāt

uccāṭanam parāhṇe ca sandhyāyām pratiṣedha kṛt
śānti karma ardharātre ca prabhāte pauṣṭikam tathā
vaśyam muktvā anya karmāṇi savya hastena yojayet
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘pūrvāhṇe’ ityādi / pūrvāhṇakāle vasantartau vaśyākṛṣṭistambhanakarmāṇi kuryāt / ‘madhyāhne prītināśanam’ madhyāhnakāle grīṣmartau vidveṣaṇaṃ kuryāt / ‘uccāṭanaṃ parāhṇe’ aparāhṇe varṣartau uccāṭanaṃ kuryāt / caḥ samuccaye / ‘sandhyāyāṃ pratiṣedhakṛt’ sandhyākāle śaradṛtau niṣedhaṃ kuryāt /
analyzed: pūrvāhṇe ityādi pūrvāhṇa kāle vasanta ṛtau vaśyā ākṛṣṭi stambhana karmāṇi kuryāt madhyāhne prīti nāśanam madhyāhna kāle grīṣma ṛtau vidveṣaṇam kuryāt uccāṭanam parāhṇe aparāhṇe varṣa ṛtau uccāṭanam kuryāt caḥ samuccaye sandhyāyām pratiṣedha kṛt sandhyā kāle śarad ṛtau niṣedham kuryāt

original: ‘śāntikarmārdharātre ca’ ardharātre hemantartau śāntikarma kuryāt / caḥ samuccaye / ‘prabhāte pauṣṭikaṃ tathā’ prabhātasamaye śiśirartau pauṣṭikaṃ karma kuryāt / ‘vaśyaṃ muktvā’ vaśyakarma varjayitvā / ‘anyakarmāṇi’ itarākṛṣṭikarmāṇi ‘savyahastena’ dakṣiṇahastena ‘yojayet’ kuryāt, vaśyakarmaiva vāmahastena yojayed ity arthaḥ // 3.6–7 //
analyzed: śānti karma ardharātre ca ardharātre hemanta ṛtau śānti karma kuryāt caḥ samuccaye prabhāte pauṣṭikam tathā prabhāta samaye śiśira ṛtau pauṣṭikam karma kuryāt vaśyam muktvā vaśya karma varjayitvā anya karmāṇi itara ākṛṣṭi karmāṇi savya hastena dakṣiṇa hastena yojayet kuryāt vaśya karma eva vāma hastena yojayet iti arthaḥ 367

original: ‘aṅkuśa’ aṅkuśamudrā ‘ākṛṣṭi’ ākarṣaṇakarmaṇi / ‘saroja’ sarojamudrā ‘vaśya’ vaśyakarmaṇi / ‘bodha’ jñānamudrā ‘śāntika’ śāntikapauṣṭikayoḥ / ‘pravāla’ pallavamudrā ‘vidveṣaṇe’ phaṭkarmaṇi / ‘sacchaṅkha’ samyakśaṅkhamudrā ‘rodha’ stambhanakarmaṇi / ‘vajra’ vajramudrā ‘vadhasamaye’ pratiṣedhasamaye / iti ṣaṭkarmakaraṇe etā mudrāḥ ‘syuḥ’ bhaveyuḥ //

analyzed: madhura trika sammiśrita dhṛta dugdha śarkarā saṃyukta guggula kṛta yakṣa dhūpa kṛta caṇaka mātra vaṭikānām triṃśat sahasra homāt triṃśat sahasra saṃkhya vaṭikānām havanāt sidhyati siddhā bhavati kā padmāvatī devī phaṇiśekharā devī

original: ‘mantrasyānte’ mantraparisamāptau / ‘namaḥśabdaṃ’ namaḥ iti vākyam / kva? ‘devatārādhanāvidhau’ devyā mantrārādhanavidhāne saṃyojayet / ‘tu’ punaḥ / ‘tadante’ mantrārādhanānte / ‘homakāle’ havanasamaye / ‘svāhāśabdaṃ’ svāheti śabdam / ‘niyojayet’ saṃyojayet //

daśa lakṣa jāpya homāt pratyakṣaḥ bhavati sau

original: ‘daśalakṣajāpyahomāt’ daśalakṣajāpyahavanāt / ‘pratyakṣo bhavati’ sākṣāt pratyakṣo bhavati / kaḥ? ‘pārśvayakṣo 'sau’ asau pārśvanāmadheyo yakṣaḥ / kathaṃbhūtaḥ? ‘nyagrodhamūlavāsī’ vaṭavṛkṣamūlavāsī / kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ? ‘śyāmāṅgaḥ’ / punaḥ kathaṃbhūtaḥ? ‘trinayanaḥ’ trinetraḥ / ‘nūnaṃ’ niścitam //
analyzed: daśa lakṣa jāpya homāt daśa lakṣa jāpya havanāt pratyakṣaḥ bhavati sākṣāt pratyakṣaḥ bhavati kaḥ asau asau pārśva nāmadheyaḥ yakṣaḥ kathaṃbhūtaḥ nyagrodha mūla vāsī vaṭa vṛkṣa mūla vāsī kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ śyāma aṅgaḥ punar kathaṃbhūtaḥ trinayanaḥ trinetraḥ nūnam niścitam

original: mantraḥ–––oṃ hrīṃ pārśvayakṣa divyarūpa maharṣaṇa ehi ehi oṃ kroṃ hrīṃ namaḥ // yakṣārādhanavidhānamantro 'yam //

nija sainyaiḥ māyā maya samucchritaiḥ vairi lokam agra stham
vimukhīkaroti yakṣaḥ saṃgrāme nimiṣa mātreṇa

original: ‘nijasainyaiḥ’ svakīyasainyaiḥ / kathaṃbhūtaiḥ? ‘māyāmayasamucchritaiḥ’ hrīṃkārakṛtaprākārasamyagucchritaiḥ / ‘vairilokam’ śatrusenāsamūham / kathaṃbhūtam? ‘agrastham’ svakīyasainyapuraḥsthitam / ‘vimukhīkaroti’ parāṅmukhīkaroti / ko 'sau? ‘yakṣaḥ’ pārśvayakṣaḥ / kva? ‘saṃgrāme’ raṇāṅgaṇabhūmau / katham? ‘nimiṣamātreṇa’ kṣaṇamātreṇa //
analyzed: nija sainyaiḥ svakīya sainyaiḥ kathaṃbhūtaiḥ māyā maya samucchritaiḥ hrīṃkāra kṛta prākāra samyak ucchritaiḥ vairi lokam śatru senā samūham kathaṃbhūtam agra stham svakīya sainya puras sthitam vimukhīkaroti parāṅmukhīkaroti sau yakṣaḥ pārśvayakṣaḥ kva saṃgrāme raṇa aṅgaṇa bhūmau katham nimiṣa mātreṇa kṣaṇa mātreṇa

original: ‘sāntaṃ’ sakārasyāntaṃ hakāram / kathaṃbhūtam? ‘bindūrdhvarepham’ anusvāra–ūrdhvarephānvitam / evaṃ rhaṃ iti bījaṃ vilikhet / ‘bahir api’ rham akṣarabahiḥpradeśe / ‘vilikhet’ viśeṣeṇa likhet / kim? ‘āyatāṣṭābjapatram’ vistīrṇāṣṭāmbhojapatram / ‘dikṣu’ tatpatraprācyādicaturdiśāsu /
analyzed: sa antam sakārasya antam hakāram kathaṃbhūtam bindu ūrdhva repham anusvāra ūrdhva repha anvitam evam rhaṃ iti bījam vilikhet bahis api rham akṣara bahis pradeśe vilikhet viśeṣeṇa likhet kim āyata aṣṭa abja patram vistīrṇa aṣṭa ambhoja patram dikṣu tad patra prācya ādi catur diśāsu

original: ‘aiṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ smareśaḥ’ pūrvadale aiṃ iti, dakṣiṇadale śrīṃ iti, paścimadale hrīṃ iti, uttaradale klīṃ iti evaṃ likhet / ‘gajavaśakaraṇaṃ hrauṃ tathā blaiṃ puna ryūṃ’ itaravidikcaturdaleṣu dvipavaśakaraṇaṃ āgneyadale krauṃ iti, nairṛtyadale hrauṃ iti / ‘tathā’ tena prakāreṇa vāyavyadale blaiṃ iti / ‘puna ryūṃ’ paścād īśānadale ryūṃ iti likhet /
analyzed: aim śrīṃ hrīṃ smareśaḥ pūrva dale aim iti dakṣiṇa dale śrīṃ iti paścima dale hrīṃ iti uttara dale klīṃ iti evam likhet gaja vaśa karaṇam hrauṃ tathā blaiṃ punar ryūṃ itara vidiś catur daleṣu dvipa vaśa karaṇam āgneya dale krauṃ iti nairṛtya dale hrauṃ iti tathā tena prakāreṇa vāyavya dale blaiṃ iti punar ryūṃ paścāt īśāna dale ryūṃ iti likhet

original: ‘bāhye hrīṃ’ tadyantrabahiḥ hrīṃkāreṇa veṣṭayet / oṃ namo 'rhaṃ diśi likhitacaturbījakam’ oṃ namo 'rham iti padaṃ prācyādicaturdiśāsu likhitaṃ aiṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ iti catvāri bījāni / ‘homayuktaṃ’ svāhāśabdayutam / evaṃ oṃ namo 'rhaṃ aiṃ śrīṃ klīṃ svāheti mantraḥ /
analyzed: bāhye hrīṃ tad yantra bahis hrīṃkāreṇa veṣṭayet om namaḥ rhaṃ diśi likhita catur bījakam om namaḥ rhaṃ iti padam prācī ādi catur diśāsu likhitam aim śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ iti catvāri bījāni homa yuktam svāhā śabda yutam evam om namaḥ rhaṃ aim śrīṃ klīṃ svāhā iti mantraḥ

original: ‘muktiśrīvallabho 'sau bhuvanam api vaśaṃ jāyate pūjayed yaḥ’ etaccintāmaṇināmayantraṃ yaḥ pūjayed, asau pumān muktyaṅganāpriyo bhavati / ‘bhuvanam api’ loko 'pi / ‘vaśaṃ jāyate’ vaśībhavati //

original: ity ubhayabhāṣākaviśekharaśrīmalliṣeṇasūriviracite bhairavapadmāvatīkalpe devyārādhanavidhir nāma tṛtīyaḥ paricchedaḥ ||

original: ‘dvādaśapatrāmburuhaṃ’ dvādaśapatrānvitaṃ padmam / kathaṃbhūtam? ‘malavarayūṃkārasaṃyutam’ maś ca laś ca vaś ca raś ca yūṃkāraś ca malavarayūṃkārāḥ taiḥ saṃyutam / kiṃ? ‘kūṭam’ kṣakāram / evaṃ kṣmlvryūṃ iti / ‘tanmadhye nāmayutam’ kṣmlvryūṃmadhye devadattanāmayutam / ‘vilikhet’ viśeṣeṇa likhet /
analyzed: dvādaśa patra amburuham dvādaśa patra anvitam padmam kathaṃbhūtam mala vara yūṃkāra saṃyutam maḥ ca laḥ ca vaḥ ca raḥ ca yūṃkāraḥ ca mala vara yūṃkārāḥ taiḥ saṃyutam kim kūṭam kṣakāram evam iti tad madhye nāma yutam kṣml vryūṃ madhye devadatta nāma yutam vilikhet viśeṣeṇa likhet

original: ‘vilikhej jayādidevīḥ’ jayādicaturdevatā vilikhet / kva? ‘dikṣu’ caturdiśāsu / ‘svāhāntauṃkārapūrvikāḥ’ oṃ jaye svāhā iti pūrvadale, oṃ vijaye svāhā iti dakṣiṇadale, oṃ ajite svāhā iti paścimadale, oṃ aparājite svāhā ity uttaradale vilikhet /

original: ‘jhabhamahapiṇḍopetāḥ’ jhaś ca bhaś ca maś ca haś ca jhabhamahāḥ te ca te piṇḍās tair upetāḥ jhabhamahapiṇḍopetāḥ / kvā? ‘vidikṣu’ vidiśāsu / kāḥ? ‘jambhādikāḥ’ jambhādīḥ caturdevīḥ / ‘tadvad’ yathāpūrvaṃ svāhāntauṃkārapūrvikāḥ /
analyzed: jhabha maha piṇḍa upetāḥ jhaḥ ca bhaḥ ca maḥ ca haḥ ca jhabha mahāḥ te ca te piṇḍāḥ taiḥ upetāḥ jhabha maha piṇḍa upetāḥ kva vidikṣu vidiśāsu kāḥ jambha ādikāḥ jambha ādīḥ catur devīḥ tadvat yathāpūrvam svāhā anta oṃkāra pūrvikāḥ

original: oṃ jhmlvryūṃ jambhe svāhā ity āgneyyāṃ diśi, oṃ bhmlvryūṃ mohe svāhā iti nairṛtyadale, oṃ mmlvryūṃ stambhe svāhā iti vāyavyadale, oṃ hmlvryūṃ stambhini svāhā iti īśānadale likhet //

original: ‘uddharitadaleṣu tataḥ’ tasmād aṣṭapatralekhanānantaraṃ uddharitadaleṣu / katisaṃkhyopeteṣu? ‘caturṣu’ catuḥsaṃkhyeṣu / ‘makaradhvajabījam ālikhet’ klīṃkārabījam ālikhet / ‘gajavaśakaraṇaniruddhaṃ’ krauṃkāraniruddham / ‘trir māyayā veṣṭyam’ patrabāhye hrīṃkāreṇa tridhā veṣṭitam / ‘kuryāt’ karotu //
analyzed: uddharita daleṣu tatas tasmāt aṣṭa patra lekhana anantaram uddharita daleṣu kati saṃkhyā upeteṣu caturṣu catur saṃkhyeṣu makaradhvaja bījam ālikhet klīṃkāra bījam ālikhet gaja vaśa karaṇa niruddham krauṃkāra niruddham tris māyayā veṣṭyam patra bāhye hrīṃkāreṇa tridhā veṣṭitam kuryāt karotu

original: ‘bhūrje’ bhūrjapatre / ‘surabhidravyaiḥ’ kuṅkumādisugandhadravyaiḥ / ‘vilikhya’ etad mantraṃ likhitvā / ‘pariveṣṭya raktasūtreṇa’ raktasūtreṇa veṣṭayitvā / ‘nikṣipya’ saṃsthāpya / kva? ‘sulvabhāṇḍe’ apakvabhāṇḍe / kathaṃbhūte? ‘madhupūrṇe’ mākṣikapūrṇe / ‘mohayaty abalām’ abalā vanitā tāṃ mohayati //

analyzed: strī kapāle vanitā kapāle vilikhet yantram prāk kathita yantram likhet klīṃ sthāne klīṃkāra sthāne kam bhuvanādhipam hrīṃkāram likhet trisandhyam trikālam tāpayet tāpanam kuryāt rāma ākṛṣṭiḥ syāt vanitā ākarṣaṇam bhavet kena khadira agninā khadira kāṣṭha agninā strī ākarṣaṇe hrīṃrañjikāyantram

original: ‘māyāsthāne’ / hrīṃkārasthāne / ‘caḥ’ samuccaye / kam? ‘huṃkāram’ huṃ iti bījam / ‘vilikhet’ likhet / kva? ‘naracarmaṇi’ manuṣyacarmaṇi likhet / kābhyām? ‘kṣveḍaraktābhyām’ viṣagardabharudhirābhyām / ‘tāpayet’ pūrvavat tāpayet / ‘pakṣāhāt’ pakṣamadhye / ‘pratiṣedhakṛt’ pratiṣedhakāri bhavati // pratiṣedhakarmaṇi huṃrañjikāyantram //
analyzed: māyā sthāne hrīṃkāra sthāne caḥ samuccaye kam huṃkāram hum iti bījam vilikhet likhet kva nara carmaṇi manuṣya carmaṇi likhet kābhyām kṣveḍa raktābhyām viṣa gardabha rudhirābhyām tāpayet pūrvavat tāpayet pakṣa ahāt pakṣa madhye pratiṣedha kṛt pratiṣedha kāri bhavati pratiṣedha karmaṇi huṃrañjikāyantram

original: ‘huṃsthāne’ prāṅniṣiddhakarmaṇi likhitahuṃkārasthāne / ‘māntaṃ’ yakāram / ‘ālikhya’ lekhayitvā / kathaṃbhūtam? ‘sarepham’ ūrdhvarephānvitam / ‘nāmasaṃyutam’ nāmayuktam / kayoḥ? ‘dvayor api ca martyayoḥ’ api niścayena / kva? ‘bibhītaphalake’ kalitaruphalake / ‘yantraṃ’ etad yantraṃ lekhanīyam //
analyzed: huṃsthāne prāk niṣiddha karmaṇi likhita huṃkāra sthāne ma antam yakāram ālikhya lekhayitvā kathaṃbhūtam sa repham ūrdhva repha anvitam nāma saṃyutam nāma yuktam kayoḥ dvayoḥ api ca martyayoḥ api niścayena kva vibhīta phalake kali taru phalake yantram etat yantram lekhanīyam
vāji māhiṣa keśaiḥ ca viparīta mukha sthayoḥ

analyzed: āveṣṭya sthāpayet bhūmyām vidveṣam kurute tayoḥ

analyzed: nāma devadatta nāma glaum devadatta nāma upari glauṃkāram kha anta piṇḍam khakārasya antaḥ gakāraḥ sa ca asau piṇḍaḥ ca kha anta piṇḍaḥ iti piṇḍaḥ tam vasudala sahita ambhoja patre vilikhya aṣṭadala anvita padma patre viśeṣeṇa likhitvā tat piṇḍam tad karṇikā likhita gmlvryūṃ iti piṇḍam teṣu aṣṭa pattreṣu yojyam yojanīyam

original: ‘bahir api’ tad aṣṭadalakamalabahiḥpradeśe / ‘valayam’ / kena? ‘divyamantreṇa’ viśiṣṭamantreṇa / ‘kuryāt’ karotu / ‘ṭāntaṃ’ ṭhakāram / kathaṃbhūtam? ‘bhūmaṇḍalāntaṃ’ pṛthvīmaṇḍalāntaḥsthitam / divyamantravalayabahiḥpradeśe ṭhakāreṇāveṣṭya tadbahiḥ pṛthvīmaṇḍalaṃ likhet ity abhiprāyaḥ /

original: kva? ‘vipulataraśilāsampuṭe’ vistīrṇapāṣāṇasampuṭe kaiḥ? ‘kuṅkumādyaiḥ’ kāśmīrādipītadravyaiḥ / ‘dhāryaṃ’ dhāraṇīyam / kva? ‘śrīvīranāthakramayugapurataḥ’ śrīvardhamānasvāmicaraṇayugalāgrataḥ / kim artham? ‘vahnidivyopaśāntyai’ analadivyopaśāntyartham /
analyzed: kva vipulatara śilā sampuṭe vistīrṇa pāṣāṇa sampuṭe kaiḥ kuṅkuma ādyaiḥ kāśmīra ādi pīta dravyaiḥ dhāryam dhāraṇīyam kva śrī vīranātha krama yuga puratas śrī vardhamāna svāmi caraṇa yugala agratas kim artham vahni divya upaśāntyai anala divya upaśānti artham

analyzed: keṣu pūrva ukta aṣṭadaleṣu prāc vilikhita aṣṭadaleṣu kathita catur divyeṣu ca pūrvavat anyat punar sarvam anyat punar yantra uddhāram prāc likhitam yathā tathā eva sarvam

original: ‘vārtālīmantravṛtaṃ’ vajrāṇāṃ bahiḥpradeśe vārtālīmantreṇa veṣṭitam / ‘bāhye’ mantrāveṣṭanabahiḥpradeśe / ‘aṣṭasu dikṣu’ aṣṭāsu diśāsu / ‘vinyaset’ viśeṣeṇa sthāpayet / kathaṃ? ‘kramaśaḥ’ kramaparipāṭyā / ‘malavarayūṃkārayutān’ maś ca laś ca vaś ca raś ca yūṃkāraś ca malavarayūṃkārāḥ tair yutāḥ malavarayūṃkārayutāḥ tān malavarayūṃkārayutān /

original: ‘kṣamaṭhasahaparāntalāntān’ kṣaś ca maś ca ṭhaś ca saś ca haś ca paś ca laś ca vaś ca, ‘rānto’ rakārasyānto lakāraḥ laś ca, ‘lānto’ lakārasyānto vakāraḥ vaś ca, kṣamaṭhasahaparāntalāntāḥ tān / evaṃ kṣmlvryūṃ mmlvryūṃ ṭhmlvryūṃ smlvryūṃ hmlvryūṃ pmlvryūṃ lmlvryūṃ vmlvryūṃ etān aṣṭa piṇḍān /
analyzed: kṣama ṭha saha para anta lāntān kṣaḥ ca maḥ ca ṭhaḥ ca saḥ ca haḥ ca paḥ ca laḥ ca vaḥ ca ra antaḥ rakārasya antaḥ lakāraḥ laḥ ca la antaḥ lakārasya antaḥ vakāraḥ vaḥ ca kṣama ṭha saha para anta lāntāḥ tān evam mmlvryūm ṭhmlvryūm hmlvryūm pmlvryūm lmlvryūm vmlvryūm etān aṣṭa piṇḍān

original: vārtālīmantroddhāraḥ–––oṃ vārtāli varāhi varāhamukhi jambhe jambhini stambhe stambhini andhe andhini rundhe rundhini sarvaduṣṭapraduṣṭānāṃ krodhaṃ lili matiṃ lili gatiṃ lili jihvāṃ lili oṃ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ / ayaṃ vārtālīmantraḥ //
analyzed: vārtālī mantra uddhāraḥ om vārtāli varāhi varāha mukhi jambhe jambhini stambhe stambhini andhe andhini rundhe rundhini sarva duṣṭa praduṣṭānām krodham lili matim lili gatim lili jihvām lili om ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ ayam vārtālī mantraḥ
bāhye marapura parivṛtam aṅkuśa ruddham karotu tat dvāram

original: ‘bāhye’ tatpiṇḍāṣṭakabahiḥpradeśe / ‘amarapuraparivṛtam’ indrapureṇa samantād āvṛtam / ‘aṅkuśāruddhaṃ karotu taddvāram’ tad indrapuraṃ caturdvārobhayapārśve aṅkuśaḥ kroṃkāraḥ tena ruddhaṃ kuryāt / ‘ukṣeśamantraveṣṭyam’ tatpurabahiḥpradeśe ukṣā ṛṣabhas tasya īśaḥ svāmī śrīṛṣabhanāthaḥ tasya mantraḥ tena ukṣeśamantreṇāveṣṭyam /
analyzed: bāhye tad piṇḍa aṣṭaka bahis pradeśe amarapura parivṛtam indrapureṇa samantāt āvṛtam aṅkuśa āruddham karotu tad dvāram tat indrapuram catur dvāra ubhaya pārśve aṅkuśaḥ kroṃkāraḥ tena ruddham kuryāt ukṣa īśa mantra veṣṭyam tad pura bahis pradeśe ukṣā ṛṣabhaḥ tasya īśaḥ svāmī śrī ṛṣabha nāthaḥ tasya mantraḥ tena ukṣa īśa mantreṇa āveṣṭyam
kuryāt

original: ukṣeśamantroddhāraḥ–––oṃ namo bhayavado risahassa paḍinimitteṇa caraṇapaṇati iṃdeṇa bhaṇāmaï yameṇa ugdhāḍiyā jīhā kaṃṭhoṭṭhamuhatāluyā khīliyā jo maṃ bhasaï jo maṃ hasaï duṭṭhadiṭṭhīe vajjasaṃkhilāe devadattassa maṇaṃ hiyayaṃ kohaṃ jīhā khīliyā selakhilāe la la la la ṭha ṭha ṭha ṭha // ukṣeśamantro 'yaṃ, prākṛtamantraḥ //
analyzed: ukṣa īśa mantra uddhāraḥ om namaḥ bhayavataḥ iṃdeṇa bhaṇāmañ yameṇa ugdhāḍiyā jīhā kaṃṭha uṭṭha muha tāluyā khīliyā jaḥ mama bhasaï jaḥ mama hasaï duṭṭha diṭṭhīe vajja saṃkhilāe devadattassa maṇam hiyayam koham jīhā khīliyā selakhilāe la la la la ṭha ṭha ṭha ukṣa īśa mantraḥ yam prākṛta mantraḥ

original: ‘koṇeṣv aṣṭasu’ ukṣeśamantravalayabahir aṣṭasu diśāsu / ‘vilikhet’ viśeṣeṇa likhet / kān? ‘vārtālīmantrabhaṇitajambhādīn’ vārtālīmantrābhyantare kathitajambhādyaṣṭadevatāḥ /
analyzed: koṇeṣu aṣṭasu ukṣa īśa mantra valaya bahis aṣṭasu diśāsu vilikhet viśeṣeṇa likhet kān vārtālī mantra bhaṇita jambha ādīn vārtālī mantra abhyantare kathita jambha ādi aṣṭa devatāḥ

original: oṃ jambhe svāhā, oṃ jambhini svāhā, oṃ stambhe svāhā, oṃ stambhini svāhā, oṃ andhe svāhā, oṃ andhini svāhā, oṃ rundhe svāhā, oṃ rundhini svāhā ity aṣṭadevatāḥ prācyādyaṣṭadiśāsu krameṇa sthāpyāḥ / ‘ṭhadvitayaṃ’ jambhādidevībahiḥpradeśe ṭhakāradvitayam / ‘dharaṇīpuram’ ṭhakārabahiḥpradeśe pṛthvīmaṇḍalam / ‘īdṛśaṃ’ anena kathitaprakāreṇa /

phalake śilā tale vā haritāla manaḥśilā ādibhiḥ likhitam

vārtālīyantra uddhāraḥ samāptaḥ

original: nāma glaum urvīpuraṃ vaṃ paṃ glauṃkāraveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā |
analyzed: nāma glaum urvī puram vaṃ paṃ glauṃ kāraveṣṭitam kṛtvā
hrīṃkāra catur valayam sva nāma yuktam tatas lekhyam 511

original: ‘nāma’ devadattanāma / ‘glauṃ’ tannāmopari glauṃkāram / ‘urvīpuraṃ’ tadupari pṛthvīmaṇḍalam / ‘vaṃ paṃ glauṃkāraveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā’ urvīpurabahiḥpradeśe ‘vaṃ’ vaṃkāraṃ, tasyopari ‘paṃ’ paṃkāraṃ, paṃkāropari glauṃkāraṃ, etair akṣaratrayair veṣṭanaṃ kārayitvā / hrīṃkāracaturvalayam / kathambhūtam? ‘svanāmayuktam’ tad hrīṃkāraṃ svakīyanāmānvitam /

om ucchiṣṭa padasya agre svacchanda padam ālikhet

analyzed: om om iti akṣaram ucchiṣṭa padasya ucchiṣṭa iti padam tasya agre ucchiṣṭa padasya agre svacchanda padam svacchanda iti padam ālikhet samantāt likhet tatas cāṇḍālini svāhā tatas svacchanda padāt cāṇḍālini svāhā iti

original: evaṃ mantroddhāraḥ–––oṃ ucchiṣṭasvacchandacāṇḍālini svāhā // iti mantravinyāsaḥ // ‘ṭāntayugmakaveṣṭitam’ ṭhakāradvayena veṣṭitam //
analyzed: evam mantra uddhāraḥ om ucchiṣṭa svacchanda cāṇḍālini svāhā iti mantra vinyāsaḥ ṭānta yugmaka veṣṭitam ṭhakāra dvayena veṣṭitam

original: ‘tat’ tad yantram / ‘kulālakaramṛttikāvṛtam’ kumbhakārakarāgramṛdāveṣṭitam / ‘toyapūritaghaṭe’ jalaparipūrṇanavaghaṭe / ‘vinikṣipet’ nidadhyāt / ‘śrīpārśvanāthaṃ’ śrīpārśvabhaṭṭārakam / kathaṃbhūtam? ‘uparisthaṃ’ tatkumbhopari sthitam / ‘arcayet’ pūjayet / ‘divyarodhanavidhānam’ divyastambhakaraṇam / ‘uttamaṃ’ śreṣṭham /

divya stambhanayantram idam
ripu nāma anvitam āntam malavara yūṃkāra saṃyutam ṭāntam
tad bāhye bhūmi puram triśūla bhūta ugra mṛga veṣṭyam

original: ‘haṃsāvṛtam’ haṃsa iti padenāvṛtaṃ––veṣṭitam / kiṃ tat? ‘abhidhānam’ devadattanāma / ‘lavarayaṣaṣṭhasvarānvitam’ laś ca vaś ca raś ca yaś ca ṣaṣṭhasvaraś ca ūkāraḥ etair anvitaṃ––yuktam / kiṃ tat? ‘kūṭam’ kṣakāram / punaḥ kathaṃbhūtam? ‘binduyutam’ anusvārasaṃyuktam, evaṃ kṣmlvryūṃ iti piṇḍaṃ haṃsapadād bahir deyam /
analyzed: haṃsa āvṛtam haṃsaḥ iti padena āvṛtam veṣṭitam kim tat abhidhānam devadatta nāma la va raya ṣaṣṭha svara anvitam laḥ ca vaḥ ca raḥ ca yaḥ ca ṣaṣṭha svaraḥ ca ūkāraḥ etaiḥ anvitam yuktam kim tat kūṭam kṣakāram punar kathaṃbhūtam bindu yutam anusvāra saṃyuktam evam iti piṇḍam haṃsa padāt bahis deyam

original: punar api kathaṃbhūtam? ‘svaraparivṛtam’ piṇḍād bahiḥ svarair āveṣṭitam / punaḥ kathaṃbhūtam? ‘aṣṭadalāmbhojamadhyagatam’ aṣṭadalakamalamadhye sthitam //

original: tejo rhaṃ soma sudhā haṃsaḥ svāheti digdaleṣu likhet |

āgneyī ādi daleṣu api piṇḍam yat karṇikā likhitam
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘tejo rhaṃ soma sudhā haṃsaḥ svāhā’ tejaḥ––oṃkāraḥ, ‘rhaṃ’ rham iti akṣaraṃ, somaḥ kvīṃkāraḥ, sudhā kṣvīṃkāraḥ, ‘haṃsaḥ’ haṃsa iti padam, ‘svāhā’ svāhā iti padam / evaṃ oṃ rhaṃ kvīṃ kṣvīṃ haṃsaḥ svāhā ity evaṃviśiṣṭamantraṃ ‘digdaleṣu’ prācyādiṣu catuḥpatreṣu likhet /
analyzed: tejaḥ rham soma sudhā haṃsaḥ svāhā tejaḥ oṃkāraḥ rhaṃ rham iti akṣaram somaḥ kvīṃkāraḥ sudhā kṣvīṃkāraḥ haṃsaḥ haṃsaḥ iti padam svāhā svāhā iti padam evam om rhaṃ kvīṃ kṣvīṃ haṃsaḥ svāhā iti evam viśiṣṭa mantram diś daleṣu prācī ādiṣu catur pattreṣu likhet

original: ‘āgneyyādidaleṣv api’ paścāt āgneyyādividiggatacaturdaleṣu ‘piṇḍaṃ yat karṇikālikhitam’ yat karṇikābhyantare likhitaṃ kṣmlvryūṃ iti piṇḍaṃ vidikpatreṣu likhet //
analyzed: āgneyī ādi daleṣu api paścāt āgneyī ādi vidiś gata catur daleṣu piṇḍam yat karṇikā likhitam yat karṇikā abhyantare likhitam iti piṇḍam vidiś patreṣu likhet

original: bhūrje surabhidravyair vilikhya tat sikthakena pariveṣṭya |
analyzed: bhūrje surabhi dravyaiḥ vilikhya tat sikthakena pariveṣṭya
nūtana ghaṭe mbu pūrṇe tat yantram sthāpayet dhīmān
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘bhūrje’ bhūrjapatre ‘surabhidravyaiḥ’ kuṅkumakarpūrādisugandhadravyaiḥ ‘vilikhya’ viśeṣeṇa likhitvā ‘tat’ tal likhitayantram ‘sikthakena’ madhūcchiṣṭena ‘pariveṣṭya’ samantād āveṣṭya / ‘nūtanaghaṭe’ navakumbhe / kathaṃbhūte? ‘ambupūrṇe’ śītalajalaparipūrṇe / ‘tad yantraṃ’ tat sikthakena veṣṭitaṃ yantram ‘sthāpayet’ nikṣipet /
analyzed: bhūrje bhūrja patre surabhi dravyaiḥ kuṅkuma karpūra ādi sugandha dravyaiḥ vilikhya viśeṣeṇa likhitvā tat tat likhita yantram sikthakena madhūcchiṣṭena pariveṣṭya samantāt āveṣṭya nūtana ghaṭe nava kumbhe kathaṃbhūte ambu pūrṇe śītala jala paripūrṇe tat yantram tat sikthakena veṣṭitam yantram sthāpayet nikṣipet
kaḥ dhīmān buddhimān

original: tandulapūrṇaṃ mṛṇmayabhājanam apy upari tasya saṃsthāpya |
analyzed: tandula pūrṇam mṛṇmaya bhājanam api upari tasya saṃsthāpya
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘tandulapūrṇam’ śālyakṣatabharitam ‘mṛṇmayabhājanam’ mṛdā nirmitapātram ‘api’ paścāt ‘upari tasya’ pūrṇakumbhasyopari ‘saṃsthāpya’ samyak sthāpayitvā / katham? ‘śrīpārśvanāthasahitam’ tandulopari śrīpārśvanāthajinapratimāyuktam / evaṃ vidhānena kṛte sati ‘karoti’ kurute / kam? ‘dāhajvaropaśamam’ dāhajvarasya śāntim //
analyzed: tandula pūrṇam śāli akṣata bharitam mṛṇmaya bhājanam mṛdā nirmita pātram api paścāt upari tasya pūrṇa kumbhasya upari saṃsthāpya samyak sthāpayitvā katham śrīpārśvanātha sahitam tandula upari śrīpārśvanātha jina pratimā yuktam evam vidhānena kṛte sati karoti kurute kam dāha jvara upaśamam dāha jvarasya śāntim
śrīkhaṇḍena tat ālikhya pāyayet kāṃsya bhājane
mahā dāha jvara grastam tad kṣaṇena upaśāmyati 75
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘śrīkhaṇḍena’ makhāśrayeṇa ‘tat’ prākkathitayantram ‘ālikhya’ likhitvā ‘pāyayet’ āturaṃ pāyayet / tat kva likhitvā? ‘kāṃsyabhājane’ kāṃsyanirmitapātre / kam? ‘mahādāhajvaragrastam’ tīvroṣṇajvaragṛhītam / ‘tad’ dāhajvaram ‘kṣaṇena’ nimiṣamātreṇa ‘upaśāmyati’ upaśamaṃ prāpnoti //
analyzed: śrīkhaṇḍena makha āśrayeṇa tat prāc kathita yantram ālikhya likhitvā pāyayet āturam pāyayet tat kva likhitvā kāṃsya bhājane kāṃsya nirmita pātre kam mahā dāha jvara grastam tīvra uṣṇa jvara gṛhītam tat dāha jvaram kṣaṇena nimiṣa mātreṇa upaśāmyati upaśamam prāpnoti

original: mantroddhāraḥ–––oṃ kṣmlvryūṃ rhaṃ kvīṃ kṣvīṃ haṃsaḥ asiāusā svāhā /
analyzed: mantra uddhāraḥ om rhaṃ kvīṃ kṣvīṃ haṃsaḥ asi āusā svāhā
patreṣu padma avara mūlamantram veṣṭyam tad ākārṣaṇa pallavena
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘kleṃtattvakūṭenduvṛtam’ ‘kleṃ’ kleṃkāraṃ, ‘tattvaṃ’ hrīṃkāram, ‘kaṭaṃ’ kṣakāram, ‘induḥ’ ṭhakāraḥ, taiḥ ‘vṛtam’ ebhiś caturbījair āveṣṭitam / kiṃ tat? ‘svanāma’ svakīyanāma / ‘tadbāhyabhāge’ tadbījākṣarabahiḥpradeśe / ‘aṣṭadalābjapatram’ aṣṭadalakamalapatram /
‘patreṣu’ taddalapatreṣu ‘padmāvaramūlamantram’ padmāvatīdevyā viśiṣṭamūlamantram ‘veṣṭyaṃ tad’ tad yantraṃ veṣṭanīyam / kena? ‘ākarṣaṇapallavena’ saṃvauṣaṭ iti pallavena //
analyzed: patreṣu tad dala patreṣu padmāvara mūlamantram padmāvatī devyāḥ viśiṣṭa mūlamantram veṣṭyam tat tat yantram veṣṭanīyam kena ākarṣaṇa pallavena saṃvauṣaṭ iti pallavena

original: mantroddhāraḥ–––oṃ hrīṃ hraiṃ hsklīṃ padme padmakaṭini namaḥ //
analyzed: mantra uddhāraḥ om hrīṃ

original: yantraṃ tataś cārdhaśaśipraveṣṭyaṃ vilikhya yantraṃ phalake vaṭasya |

original: ‘yantram’ etat kathitayantram ‘tataḥ’ tasmāl lekhanānantaram ‘caḥ’ samuccaye, ‘ardhaśaśipraveṣṭyam’ ardhacandrarekhayā veṣṭyam / ‘vilikhya’ viśeṣeṇa likhitvā ‘yantraṃ’ etad yantram / kva? ‘phalake’ paṭṭikāyām / kasya? ‘vaṭasya’ nyagrodhavṛkṣasya / kaiḥ kṛtvā? ‘gorocanāsaṃyutakuṅkumādyaiḥ’ gorocanānvitakuṅkumādidravyaiḥ /
analyzed: yantram etat kathita yantram tatas tasmāt lekhana anantaram caḥ samuccaye ardhaśaśipraveṣṭyam ardhacandrarekhayā veṣṭyam vilikhya viśeṣeṇa likhitvā yantram etat yantram kva phalake paṭṭikāyām kasya vaṭasya nyagrodha vṛkṣasya kaiḥ kṛtvā gorocanā saṃyuta kuṅkuma ādyaiḥ gorocanā anvita kuṅkuma ādi dravyaiḥ

analyzed: sandhyāsu nityam karavīra puṣpaiḥ bhavet avaśyam japataḥ su sādhyam
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘tataḥ’ tasmād anantaram / ‘caḥ’ samuccaye / ‘ubhayasampuṭaṃ ca’ sādhyasādhakayor likhitayantrasampuṭam ‘kṛtvā’ viracayya / ‘śrīpārśvanāthasya’ śrīpārśvanāthatīrthaṃkarasya ‘puraḥ’ agre ‘niveśya’ saṃsthāpya / kāsu? ‘sandhyāsu’ triṣu sandhyāsu / ‘nityaṃ’ sarvakālam ‘japataḥ’ jāpyaṃ kurvataḥ / kaiḥ? ‘karavīrapuṣpaiḥ’ raktakaravīrapuṣpaiḥ /
analyzed: tatas tasmāt anantaram caḥ samuccaye ubhaya sampuṭam ca sādhya sādhakayoḥ likhita yantra sampuṭam kṛtvā viracayya śrī pārśvanāthasya śrī pārśvanātha tīrthaṃkarasya puras agre niveśya saṃsthāpya kāsu sandhyāsu triṣu sandhyāsu nityam sarvakālam japataḥ jāpyam kurvataḥ kaiḥ karavīra puṣpaiḥ rakta karavīra puṣpaiḥ
japataḥ puruṣasya avaśyam niścayena su sādhyam samyak sādhyam bhavet syāt
antya varga tṛtīya turya vakāra tattva vṛta āhvayam
haṃsa varṇa vṛtam tatas dvi guṇīkṛta aṣṭa dala ambujam
teṣu ṣoḍaśa sat kalāḥ śirasā ūna śūnya vṛtam bahis
māyayā pariveṣṭitam praṇava ādika ādibhiḥ āvṛtam
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘antyavargaḥ’ śavargaḥ / ‘tṛtīyaḥ’ tasya śavargasya tṛtīyākṣaraḥ sakāraḥ / ‘turyaḥ’ caturthaḥ hakāraḥ / ‘vakāraḥ’ vakārākṣaram / ‘tattvaṃ’ hrīṃkāraḥ / ‘vṛtāhvayam’ etaiś caturbhir akṣarair āveṣṭitadevadattanāma / ‘haṃsavarṇavṛtam’ tadakṣaracatuṣṭayād bahiḥ ‘haṃsaḥ’ iti varṇair āvṛtam /
analyzed: antya vargaḥ śavargaḥ tṛtīyaḥ tasya śavargasya tṛtīya akṣaraḥ sakāraḥ turyaḥ caturthaḥ hakāraḥ vakāraḥ vakāra akṣaram tattvam hrīṃkāraḥ vṛta āhvayam etaiḥ caturbhiḥ akṣaraiḥ āveṣṭita devadatta nāma haṃsa varṇa vṛtam tad akṣara catuṣṭayāt bahis haṃsaḥ iti varṇaiḥ āvṛtam

original: ‘tataḥ’ haṃsavalayāt ‘dviguṇīkṛtāṣṭadalāmbujam’ ṣoḍaśadalapadmam / ‘teṣu’ ṣoḍaśadaleṣu ‘ṣoḍaśa satkalāḥ’ akārādiṣoḍaśasvarāḥ / ‘śirasonaśūnyavṛtaṃ bahiḥ’ tatsvarād bahiḥ śirorahitahakārair veṣṭitam / ‘māyayā’ hrīṃkāreṇa ‘pariveṣṭitam’ samantād veṣṭitam /
analyzed: tatas haṃsa valayāt dvi guṇīkṛta aṣṭa dala ambujam ṣoḍaśa dala padmam teṣu ṣoḍaśa daleṣu ṣoḍaśa sat kalāḥ akāra ādi ṣoḍaśa svarāḥ śirasā ūna śūnya vṛtam bahis tad svarāt bahis śiraḥ rahita hakāraiḥ veṣṭitam māyayā hrīṃkāreṇa pariveṣṭitam samantāt veṣṭitam

original: ‘praṇavādikādibhiḥ’ tad hrīṃkārād bahiḥpradeśe praṇava ādir yeṣāṃ te kakārādayaḥ taiḥ kādibhir āvṛtam / oṃ ka, oṃ kha, oṃ ga, oṃ gha, oṃ ṅa, oṃ ca, ity anena prakāreṇa hakāraparyantaṃ veṣṭanīyam //
analyzed: praṇava ādika ādibhiḥ tat hrīṃkārāt bahis pradeśe praṇavaḥ ādiḥ yeṣām te kakāra ādayaḥ taiḥ ka ādibhiḥ āvṛtam om ka om kha om ga om gha om ṅa om ca iti anena prakāreṇa hakāra paryantam veṣṭanīyam
yantram āvilikhet idam hima kuṅkuma aguru candanaiḥ
bhūrjake phalake bhuvi gomayena vimārjite
pratyaham vidhinā samam japataḥ bhṛśam
tasya pāda saroja ṣaṭpada saṃnibham bhuvana trayam
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘yantram’ etat kathitayantram ‘āvilikhet’ samantāt likhet / kaiḥ? ‘himakuṅkumāgurucandanaiḥ’ karpūrakāśmīrāguruśrīgandhādisurabhidravyaiḥ / kva? ‘bhūrjake’ bhūrjapatre / ‘phalake’ vaṭaphalake / ‘athavā’ anyena prakāreṇa vā ‘bhuvi’ pṛthivyām /
analyzed: yantram etat kathita yantram āvilikhet samantāt likhet kaiḥ hima kuṅkuma aguru candanaiḥ karpūra kāśmīra aguru śrī gandha ādi surabhi dravyaiḥ kva bhūrjake bhūrja patre phalake vaṭa phalake athavā anyena prakāreṇa vā bhuvi pṛthivyām

original: ‘gomayena’ bhūmyapatitagośakṛtā ‘vimārjite’ vilipte ‘pratyahaṃ’ dinaṃ dinaṃ prati ‘vidhinā’ yathāvidhānena ‘samaṃ’ saha ‘japataḥ’ japaṃ kurvataḥ / kaiḥ? ‘aruṇaprasavaiḥ’ raktakaravīrapuṣpaiḥ / ‘bhṛśaṃ’ atyartham / ‘tasya’ anena prakāreṇa japatas tasya puruṣasya / ‘pādasarojaṣaṭpadasaṃnibhaṃ’ pādakamalabhramarasadṛśam /
analyzed: gomayena bhūmi apatita go śakṛtā vimārjite vilipte pratyaham dinam dinam prati vidhinā yathā vidhānena samam saha japataḥ japam kurvataḥ kaiḥ aruṇa prasavaiḥ rakta karavīra puṣpaiḥ bhṛśam atyartham tasya anena prakāreṇa japataḥ tasya puruṣasya pāda saroja ṣaṭpada saṃnibham pāda kamala bhramara sadṛśam

original: kim? ‘bhuvanatrayam’ jagattrayaṃ tasya puruṣasya vaśavarti syāt ity abhiprāyaḥ /
analyzed: kim bhuvanatrayam jagattrayam tasya puruṣasya vaśa varti syāt iti abhiprāyaḥ

original: mantraḥ–––oṃ hrīṃ hsklīṃ blūṃ rhaṃ asiāusā anāhatavidyāyai namaḥ //
analyzed: mantraḥ om hrīṃ hsklīṃ blūṃ rhaṃ asi āusā anāhatavidyāyai namaḥ
brahma antara gatam nāma māyayā pariveṣṭitam

Vivaraṇa

original: ‘brahmāntaragataṃ’ oṃkāramadhyasthitam ‘nāma’ devadattanāma / kathaṃbhūtam? ‘māyayā pariveṣṭitam’ hrīṃkāreṇa pariveṣṭitam / punar api hrīṃkārād bahiḥ ‘kāmarājena’ klīṃkāreṇa ‘veṣṭitaṃ’ pariveṣṭitam / ‘bāhye’ klīṃkārabāhye ‘ṣoḍaśapatrakaṃ’ ṣoḍaśadalapadmam //
analyzed: brahma antara gatam oṃkāra madhya sthitam nāma devadatta nāma kathaṃbhūtam māyayā pariveṣṭitam hrīṃkāreṇa pariveṣṭitam punar api hrīṃkārāt bahis kāmarājena klīṃkāreṇa veṣṭitam pariveṣṭitam bāhye klīṃkāra bāhye ṣoḍaśa patrakam ṣoḍaśa dala padmam
pañca bāṇān nyaset teṣu svāhā anta oṃkāra pūrvakān
tad bāhye māyayā veṣṭyam kroṃkāreṇa nirodhayet

original: ‘sā kaṅgutailabhāvyā’ sā kṛtā vartiḥ kaṅgutailena bhāvanīyā / ‘tayā’ evaṃvidhavartyā / ‘pradīpaṃ’ prakāśitadīpam / ‘vibodhayet’ prajvālayet / kaḥ? ‘mantrī’ mantravādī / ‘yatrādhomukham agamad dīpaḥ’ tatra yasmin sthale taddīpaḥ adhomukhaṃ gacchati ‘tatrāsti vasurāśiḥ’ tasmin sthale suvarṇarāśir astīti jñātavyam //
analyzed: sā kaṅgu taila bhāvyā sā kṛtā vartiḥ kaṅgu tailena bhāvanīyā tayā evaṃvidha vartyā pradīpam prakāśita dīpam vibodhayet prajvālayet kaḥ mantrī mantra vādī yatra adhomukham agamat dīpaḥ tatra yasmin sthale tad dīpaḥ adhomukham gacchati tatra asti vasu rāśiḥ tasmin sthale suvarṇa rāśiḥ asti iti jñātavyam

original: ‘vinayādi’ oṃkārapūrvam ‘prajvalitajyotir diśāyām’ iti padam / punaḥ kathaṃbhūtam? ‘marunnabho'ntapadam’ svāhāśabdānvitam / ‘prapaṭhan manasā mantraṃ’ evaṃ viśiṣṭamantraṃ mānasenoccārayan / ‘pradīpaṃ’ prakṛṣṭaṃ dīpam / ‘ālokayet’ vilokayet / kaḥ? ‘mantrī’ mantravādī //

original: mantroddhāraḥ–––oṃ jvalitajyotir diśāyāṃ svāhā / iyaṃ dīpavartiḥ aśvakhure churikāyāṃ vā pratibodhya saṃsthāpyāvalokanīyā //

original: ‘prāya’ bālayuvavṛddheti trividhaprāyamadhye nāmaikam, ‘urvīśa’ sārvabhaumānāṃ rājñāṃ madhye nāmaikaṃ, ‘nadī’ gaṅgādimahānadīnāṃ madhye nāmaikaṃ, ‘navagraha’ ādityādinavagrahāṇāṃ madhye nāmaikam, ‘naga’ mandarādiparvatānāṃ madhye nāmaikaṃ, ‘vyādhi’ vātapittaśleṣmodbhavānāṃ madhye nāmaikaṃ, ‘prasūna’ mallikājātiśatapatrādipuṣpāṇāṃ madhye nāmaikam,
analyzed: bāla yuva vṛddha iti trividha prāya madhye nāma ekam urvī īśa sārvabhaumānām rājñām madhye nāma ekam nadī gaṅgā ādi mahā nadīnām madhye nāma ekam nava grahaḥ āditya ādi nava grahāṇām madhye nāma ekam naga mandara ādi parvatānām madhye nāma ekam vyādhi vāta pitta śleṣma udbhavānām madhye nāma ekam prasūna mallikā jāti śatapatra ādi puṣpāṇām madhye nāma ekam

original: ‘akṣarāṇi’ prāyādiprasūnāntānāṃ praśnakathitākṣarasaṃkhyām / ‘ekīkṛtya’ tāni sarvāṇy apy ekatrāṅkaṃ kṛtvā / ‘nakhānvitaṃ’ tadaṅkarāśimadhye viṃśatyaṅkaṃ yojayitvā / ‘triguṇitaṃ’ tat saptarāśi tribhir guṇitaṃ kṛtvā, ‘tithyā punar bhājitam’ punaḥ paścāt triguṇitarāśiṃ pañcadaśabhiḥ saṃkhyair vibhajya / ‘brūyāt’ kathayet /
analyzed: akṣarāṇi prāya ādi prasūna antānām praśna kathita akṣara saṃkhyām ekīkṛtya tāni sarvāṇi api ekatra aṅkam kṛtvā nakha anvitam tad aṅka rāśi madhye viṃśati aṅkam yojayitvā tri guṇitam tat sapta rāśi tribhiḥ guṇitam kṛtvā tithyā punar bhājitam punar paścāt tri guṇita rāśim pañcadaśabhiḥ saṃkhyaiḥ vibhajya brūyāt kathayet

original: kasmāt? ‘uddharitāt’ bhāgāvaśeṣāt / kiṃ? ‘śubhāśubhaphalaṃ’ śubhaphalam aśubhaphalaṃ ca / kasmin? ‘vaiṣamyasāmye’ viṣamāṅke śubhaphalaṃ brūyāt, samāṅke viruddhaphalaṃ brūyāt / kaḥ? ‘sudhīḥ’ dhīmān / ‘etat tathyaṃ’ etat praśnanimittaṃ niścitaṃ satyam / ‘iha’ asmin kalpe / ‘uditaṃ’ pratipāditam / kaiḥ? munivaraiḥ munivṛṣabhaiḥ /
analyzed: kasmāt uddharitāt bhāga avaśeṣāt kim śubha aśubha phalam śubha phalam aśubha phalam ca kasmin vaiṣamya sāmye viṣama aṅke śubha phalam brūyāt sama aṅke viruddha phalam brūyāt kaḥ sudhīḥ dhīmān etat tathyam etat praśna nimittam niścitam satyam iha asmin kalpe uditam pratipāditam kaiḥ muni varaiḥ muni vṛṣabhaiḥ

original: kathambhūtaiḥ? bhavyābjagharmāṃśubhiḥ bhavyā eva abjāni teṣāṃ gharmāṃśur ādityas tad vartair munibhiḥ iti praśnaḥ //

original: ‘ardhendurekhāgragatam’ ardhacandrākārarekhāgrasthitam / kiṃ tat? ‘triśūlam’ triśūlākāram, na kevalacandrākārāgragataṃ triśūlam / ‘madhye ca’ tad ardhacandrākārarekhāmadhye 'pi ca triśūlam / ‘samyak pravilikhya’ śobhanaṃ prakarṣeṇa likhitvā / kaḥ? ‘dhīmān’ buddhimān / ‘ṛkṣe’ nakṣatre / ‘amavāsyāpratipaddine tu’ amāvāsyānivartamānapratipaddine tu /
analyzed: ardhendu rekhā agra gatam ardha candra ākāra rekhā agra sthitam kim tat triśūlam triśūla ākāram na kevala candra ākāra agra gatam triśūlam madhye ca tat ardha candra ākāra rekhā madhye ca triśūlam samyak pravilikhya śobhanam prakarṣeṇa likhitvā kaḥ dhīmān buddhimān ṛkṣe nakṣatre amavāsyā pratipad dine tu amāvāsyā nivartamāna pratipad dine tu

original: ‘kṛtvā tadādiṃ’ tatpratipaddine yasmin nakṣatre mṛgāṅkas tiṣṭhati taṃ nakṣatraṃ triśūlarekhāgre saṃsthāpya tan nakṣatram ādiṃ kṛtvā / ‘vigaṇayya’, kva? ‘yuddhe’, yasmin dine yuddhe yasya yudhyamānasya puruṣasya janmanakṣatraṃ yatra labhyate tatparyantaṃ gaṇayet / ‘triśūlāgragateṣu mṛtyum’ janmanakṣatraṃ triśūlāgragataṃ yadā bhavati tadā mṛtyum /
analyzed: kṛtvā tad ādim tad pratipad dine yasmin nakṣatre mṛgāṅkaḥ tiṣṭhati tam nakṣatram triśūla rekhā agre saṃsthāpya tat nakṣatram ādim kṛtvā vigaṇayya kva yuddhe yasmin dine yuddhe yasya yudhyamānasya puruṣasya janma nakṣatram yatra labhyate tad paryantam gaṇayet triśūla agra gateṣu mṛtyum janma nakṣatram triśūla agra gatam yadā bhavati tadā mṛtyum

original: ‘vindyāt’ jānīyāt / ‘mārtaṇḍasaṃkhyeṣu jayaṃ ca teṣu’ ardhacandrākārarekhābhyantaragatadvādaśarkṣeṣu teṣu jayaṃ syāt / ‘parājayaṃ ṣaṭsu bahiḥsthiteṣu’ ardhacandrākārarekhābahiḥsthiteṣu ṣaḍakṣeṣu parājayaḥ syāt //

original: ‘diśi vidiśi’ diśāsu vidiśāsu / ‘tad ubhayāntaravartibhyāṃ’ tad ubhayapārśvavartibhyāṃ tad digvidigbhyāṃ ubhayapārśvasthitānām / ‘diśatu’ kathayatu / ‘pṛcchake’ praśnakāripuruṣe / kaḥ? ‘mantrī’ mantravādī / katham? ‘kramaśaḥ’ yathākramam /
analyzed: diśi vidiśi diśāsu vidiśāsu tat ubhaya antara vartibhyām tat ubhaya pārśva vartibhyām tat diś vidigbhyām ubhaya pārśva sthitānām diśatu kathayatu pṛcchake praśna kāri puruṣe kaḥ mantrī mantra vādī katham kramaśas yathākramam

original: ‘bālaṃ bālāṃ napuṃsakam’ diśi pṛcchake bālaṃ, vidiśi pṛcchake kumārīṃ diśatu, tad digvidigbhyāṃ madhye vartini pṛcchake napuṃsakaṃ diśatu / kasyāḥ? ‘pūrṇagarbhiṇyāḥ’ sampūrṇagarbhiṇyāḥ //

varṇa mātrāḥ ca dampatyoḥ ekīkṛtya tri bhājitāḥ
śūnyena ekena mṛd puṃsaḥ nāryāḥ dvi aṅkena nirdiśet
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘varṇamātrāś ca’ varṇāḥ kakārādihakāraparyantāḥ, mātrāś ca akārādiṣoḍaśasvarāḥ / kayoḥ? ‘dampatyoḥ’ strīpuṃsoḥ / ‘ekīkṛtya’ tayor nāmavarṇamātrāś ca pṛthak pṛthag viśleṣya tāḥ sarvā ekasthāne kṛtvā / ‘tribhājitāḥ’ tāṃ rāśiṃ tryaṅkena vibhājitāḥ / ‘śūnyenaikena’ tadbhāgoddharitaśūnyena ekena ca / ‘mṛtpuṃsaḥ’ puruṣasya mṛtyuḥ /
analyzed: varṇa mātrāḥ ca varṇāḥ kakāra ādi hakāra paryantāḥ mātrāḥ ca akāra ādi ṣoḍaśa svarāḥ kayoḥ dampatyoḥ strī puṃsoḥ ekīkṛtya tayoḥ nāma varṇa mātrāḥ ca pṛthak pṛthak viśleṣya tāḥ sarvāḥ eka sthāne kṛtvā tri bhājitāḥ tām rāśim tri aṅkena vibhājitāḥ śūnyena ekena tad bhāga uddharita śūnyena ekena ca mṛd puṃsaḥ puruṣasya mṛtyuḥ
nāryāḥ dvi aṅkena tad uddharita dvi aṅkena nāryāḥ mṛtyum nirdiśet kathayet
iti ubhaya bhāṣā kavi śekhara śrī malliṣeṇa sūri viracite bhairavapadmāvatīkalpe nimitta adhikāraḥ aṣṭamaḥ paricchedaḥ
navamaḥ strī ādi vaśyā auṣadha paricchedaḥ
elā manaḥśilā kuṣṭam tagara utpala rocanāḥ
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘lavaṅgaṃ’ devakusumam / ‘kuṅkumam’ vālhīkam / ‘uśīraṃ’ śvetavālakam / ‘nāgakesaraṃ’ cāmpeyam / ‘rājikāḥ’ śvetasarṣapāḥ / ‘elā’ pṛthvīkā / ‘manaḥśilā’ kunaṭī / ‘kuṣṭam’ vāpyam / ‘tagaraṃ’ piṇḍītagaram / ‘utpalaṃ’ śvetakamalam / ‘rocanā’ piṅgalā //
analyzed: lavaṅgam devakusumam kuṅkumam vālhīkam uśīram śvetavālakam nāgakesaram cāmpeyam rājikāḥ śvetasarṣapāḥ elā pṛthvīkā manaḥśilā kunaṭī kuṣṭam vāpyam tagaram piṇḍītagaram utpalam śvetakamalam rocanā piṅgalā
sarvam samānam ādāya nakṣatre puṣya nāmani
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘śrīkhaṇḍaṃ’ mākhāśrayam / ‘tulasī’ sarasā / ‘pikvī’ gandhadravyam / ‘padmakaṃ’ prasiddham / ‘kuṭajānvitaṃ’ indrayavānvitam / ‘sarvaṃ samānam ādāya’ etat sarvaṃ samānabhāgaṃ gṛhītvā / ‘nakṣatre puṣyanāmani’ puṣyanāmni nakṣatre //
analyzed: śrīkhaṇḍam mākhāśrayam tulasī sarasā pikvī gandha dravyam padmakam prasiddham kuṭaja anvitam indrayava anvitam sarvam samānam ādāya etat sarvam samāna bhāgam gṛhītvā nakṣatre puṣya nāmani puṣya nāmni nakṣatre
kanyayā peṣayet sarvam hima bhūtena vāriṇā
kuru candra udaye jāte tilakam jana mohanam
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘kanyayā’ kumāryā / ‘peṣayet’ saṃcūrṇayet / ‘sarvaṃ’ tatsarvam auṣadham / kena? ‘himabhūtena vāriṇā’ himāj janitodakena / ‘kuru’ / kasmin? ‘candrodaye jāte’ amṛtodaye jāte / kiṃ? ‘tilakam’ viśeṣakam / kathaṃbhūtam? ‘janamohanam’ janavaśyakaram //
analyzed: kanyayā kumāryā peṣayet saṃcūrṇayet sarvam tat sarvam auṣadham kena hima bhūtena vāriṇā himāt janita udakena kuru kasmin candra udaye jāte amṛta udaye jāte kim tilakam viśeṣakam kathaṃbhūtam jana mohanam jana vaśya karam
nija pañca mala upetam cūrṇam vanitām vaśīkurute
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘barhiśikhā’ mayūraśikhā, ‘sitaguñjā’ śvetaguñjā ‘gorambhā’ prasiddhā / ‘bhānukīṭakasya malaṃ’ arkapatrakīṭakaviṭ / ‘nijapañcamalopetaṃ’ svakīyapañcamalopetam / ‘cūrṇaṃ’ etad dravyānvitaṃ tāmbūlacūrṇam / ‘vanitāṃ’ striyam / ‘vaśīkurute’ vaśīkaroti //
analyzed: barhiśikhā mayūraśikhā sitaguñjā śvetaguñjā gorambhā prasiddhā bhānukīṭakasya malam arka patra kīṭaka viś nija pañca mala upetam svakīya pañca mala upetam cūrṇam etat dravya anvitam tāmbūla cūrṇam vanitām striyam vaśīkurute vaśīkaroti
go bandhinī sa lajjānām vidhāya vaṭikāḥ bahūḥ
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘karavīra’ raktāśvamārajaṭā, ‘bhujaṅgākṣī’ sarpākṣījaṭā, ‘jārī’ putraṃjārī, ‘daṇḍī’ brahmadaṇḍījaṭā, ‘indravāruṇī’ viśālājaṭā, ‘gobandhinī’ adhaḥpuṣpī, priyaṅgur ity eke, ‘salajjānāṃ’ samantāj jaṭānvitānāṃ eteṣāṃ dravyāṇāṃ cūrṇaṃ sampeṣya / ‘vidhāya vaṭikā bahūḥ’ bahūr api vaṭikāḥ kṛtvā //
analyzed: rakta aśvamāra jaṭā bhujaṅgākṣī sarpākṣī jaṭā jārī putraṃjārī daṇḍī brahmadaṇḍī jaṭā indravāruṇī viśālā jaṭā gobandhinī adhaḥpuṣpī priyaṅguḥ iti eke sa lajjānām samantāt jaṭā anvitānām eteṣām dravyāṇām cūrṇam sampeṣya vidhāya vaṭikāḥ bahūḥ bahūḥ api vaṭikāḥ kṛtvā
paktvā sva mūtrataḥ dadyāt khādye strī jana mohanam
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘vaṭikābhiḥ samaṃ kṣiptvā’ prakṛtavaṭikābhiḥ samaṃ kṣiptvā kṣepayitvā / kim? ‘lavaṇam’ samudralavaṇam / kva? ‘śubhabhājane’ manojñabhāṇḍe / ‘paktvā’ pākaṃ kṛtvā / katham? ‘svamūtrataḥ’ nijamūtrataḥ / ‘dadyāt khādye’ annādiṣu dadyāt / ‘strījanamohanaṃ’ vanitājanamohanaṃ syāt //
analyzed: vaṭikābhiḥ samam kṣiptvā prakṛta vaṭikābhiḥ samam kṣiptvā kṣepayitvā kim lavaṇam samudralavaṇam kva śubha bhājane manojña bhāṇḍe paktvā pākam kṛtvā katham sva mūtrataḥ nija mūtrataḥ dadyāt khādye anna ādiṣu dadyāt strī jana mohanam vanitā jana mohanam syāt
mṛta bhujaga vadana madhye lajjarikām saṃnidhāya sita guñjām
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘mṛtabhujagavadanamadhye’ pañcatvaprāptakṛṣṇasarpāsyamadhye / ‘lajjarikāṃ’ samaṅgāmūlam / ‘saṃnidhāya’ samyag nidhāya / ‘sitaguñjāṃ’ śvetaraktikām / kiṃviśiṣṭām? ‘rudrajaṭāsammiśrām’ rudrajaṭāsaṃyuktām / ‘ākṛṣya dinatrayaṃ yāvat’ etan mūlatrayaṃ tatsarpāsye dinatrayaṃ yāvat saṃsthāpya, paścāt ‘ākṛṣya’ niṣkāsya //
analyzed: mṛta bhujaga vadana madhye pañcatva prāpta kṛṣṇa sarpa āsya madhye lajjarikām samaṅgā mūlam saṃnidhāya samyak nidhāya sita guñjām śveta raktikām kiṃviśiṣṭām rudra jaṭā sammiśrām rudra jaṭā saṃyuktām ākṛṣya dina trayam yāvat etat mūla trayam tat sarpa āsye dina trayam yāvat saṃsthāpya paścāt ākṛṣya niṣkāsya
paribhāvya śunī payasā sva malaiḥ pañcāṅga sambhūtaiḥ
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘lāṅgalikāyāḥ kande’ kalihāryāḥ kandaṃ utkīrya tad dvayasampuṭamadhye / kathaṃbhūte? ‘gomayalipte’ gośakṛtā parilipya / ‘parikṣipec cūrṇam’ prākkathitauṣadhatrayakṛtacūrṇaṃ tatkandamadhye nikṣipet / kiṃ kṛtvā? ‘paribhāvya’ tac cūrṇaṃ samyag bhāvayitvā / kena? ‘śunīpayasā’ kṛṣṇaśunīdugdhena, na kevalaṃ śunīdugdhena bhāvyam /
analyzed: lāṅgalikāyāḥ kande kalihāryāḥ kandam utkīrya tat dvaya sampuṭa madhye kathaṃbhūte gomaya lipte go śakṛtā parilipya parikṣipet cūrṇam prāk kathita auṣadha traya kṛta cūrṇam tad kanda madhye nikṣipet kim kṛtvā paribhāvya tat cūrṇam samyak bhāvayitvā kena śunī payasā kṛṣṇa śunī dugdhena na kevalam śunī dugdhena bhāvyam
sva malaiḥ pañcāṅga sambhūtaiḥ svakīya pañcāṅga janita malaiḥ api bhāvayitvā
netra śrotra malam śukram danta jihvā malam tathā
vaśyā karmaṇi mantra jñaiḥ pañcāṅga malam ucyate
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘netraṃ’ locanam, ‘śrotraṃ’ śravaṇam, tayor malam / ‘śukraṃ’ bījam / ‘dantaḥ’ radanaḥ, ‘jihvā’ rasanā ‘malaṃ’ anayor malam / ‘tathā’ tena prakāreṇa / ‘vaśyakarmaṇi’ strīvaśyakarmakaraṇe / ‘mantrajñaiḥ’ mantravidbhiḥ / ‘pañcāṅgamalam ucyate’ evaṃ pañcāṅgamalam iti kathyate //
analyzed: netram locanam śrotram śravaṇam tayoḥ malam śukram bījam dantaḥ radanaḥ jihvā rasanā malam anayoḥ malam tathā tena prakāreṇa vaśya karmaṇi strī vaśya karma karaṇe mantra jñaiḥ mantra vidbhiḥ pañcāṅga malam ucyate evam pañcāṅga malam iti kathyate

original: paktvā cūrṇam idaṃ paścāj jagad vaśyakaraṃ param |
analyzed: paktvā cūrṇam idam paścāt jagat vaśya karam param
dadyāt khādya anna pāneṣu strī puṃsoḥ ca parasparam
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘paktvā’ pākaṃ kṛtvā / ‘cūrṇam idam’ etat kathitacūrṇam / ‘paścāt’ tadanantaram / ‘jagadvaśyakaraṃ’ sakalajanavaśyakaram / ‘paraṃ’ atiśayena / ‘dadyāt’ dadātu / keṣu? ‘khādyānnapāneṣu’ khādanapāneṣu / kayoḥ? ‘strīpuṃsoś ca’ strīpuruṣayoḥ / katham? ‘parasparaṃ’ ekaikaṃ tad dadyāt vaśībhavati //
analyzed: paktvā pākam kṛtvā cūrṇam idam etat kathita cūrṇam paścāt tad anantaram jagat vaśyā karam sakala jana vaśyā karam param atiśayena dadyāt dadātu keṣu khādya anna pāneṣu khādana pāneṣu kayoḥ strī puṃsoḥ ca strī puruṣayoḥ katham parasparam ekaikam tat dadyāt vaśībhavati
tila taila dīpa vartiḥ tribhuvana jana moha kṛt bhavati
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘pañcapayastarupayasā’ nyagrodha––udumbara––aśvattha––plakṣa––vaṭī, vaṭasthāne vaṃdulam iti vadanti kecit, iti pañcakṣīravṛkṣakṣīraiḥ / na kevalaṃ pañcakṣīravṛkṣakṣīrair eva ‘potavayaṇḍakarasena’ kṛṣṇamanthelikārasena / ‘paribhāvyā’ pañcasūtravartiḥ paribhāvyā, arkatūlābjasūtrasālmalītūlapaṭṭatkapāsā iti pañcasūtrakṛtā / ‘tilatailadīpavartiḥ’ /
analyzed: pañcapayaḥ taru payasā nyagrodha audumbara aśvattha plakṣa vaṭī vaṭa sthāne vaṃdulam iti vadanti kecid iti pañca kṣīra vṛkṣa kṣīraiḥ na kevalam pañca kṣīra vṛkṣa kṣīraiḥ eva potavayaṇḍaka rasena kṛṣṇamanthelikā rasena paribhāvyā pañca sūtra vartiḥ paribhāvyā arka tūla abja sūtra sālmalī tūla paṭṭat kapāsāḥ iti pañca sūtra kṛtā tila taila dīpa vartiḥ
tribhuvana jana moha kṛt bhavati bhuvana traya sthita janānām moha kāriṇī bhavati
unmattaka bhāṇḍa gatam kramuka phalam tat vaśam kurute
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘viṣamuṣṭiḥ’ viṣadoḍikā / ‘kanakam’ kṛṣṇadhattūraḥ ‘halinī’ kalihalinī ‘piśācikā’ kapikacchukā, ‘cūrṇaṃ’ eteṣāṃ caturdravyāṇāṃ cūrṇam / ‘ambu dehabhavam’ svamūtram / ‘unmattakabhāṇḍagataṃ’ etad dravyāṇāṃ cūrṇaṃ svamūtrasahitaṃ kṛṣṇadhattūrakaphalabhāṇḍamadhye dinatrayasthitaṃ / ‘kramukaphalaṃ’ pūgīphalam /
analyzed: viṣamuṣṭiḥ viṣadoḍikā kanakam kṛṣṇadhattūraḥ halinī kalihalinī piśācikā kapikacchukā cūrṇam eteṣām catur dravyāṇām cūrṇam ambu deha bhavam sva mūtram unmattaka bhāṇḍa gatam etat dravyāṇām cūrṇam sva mūtra sahitam kṛṣṇadhattūraka phala bhāṇḍa madhye dina traya sthitam kramuka phalam pūgī phalam

original: ‘tadvaśaṃ kurute’ tatkramukaphalaṃ khādane datte strīvaśaṃ karoti //
analyzed: tad vaśam kurute tad kramuka phalam khādane datte strī vaśam karoti
kramuka phalam mukha nihitam tasmāt divasa trayeṇa saṃgṛhya
kanaka viṣa muṣṭi halinī cūrṇaiḥ pratyekam
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘kramukaphalaṃ’ pūgīphalam / ‘mukhanihitaṃ’ sarpāsye sthāpitam / ‘tasmāt’ sarpamukhāt / ‘divasatrayeṇa saṃgṛhya’ tatkramukaphalaṃ dinatrayānantaraṃ gṛhītvā / ‘kanakaviṣamuṣṭihalinīcūrṇaiḥ’ dhattūrakamūlacūrṇam, viṣaḍoḍikācūrṇaṃ, halinīcūrṇam, ‘pratyekaṃ’ pṛthak pṛthak ‘saṃkṣiptvā(pya)’ nikṣipya //
analyzed: kramuka phalam pūgī phalam mukha nihitam sarpa āsye sthāpitam tasmāt sarpa mukhāt divasa trayeṇa saṃgṛhya tat kramuka phalam dina traya anantaram gṛhītvā kanaka viṣa muṣṭi halinī cūrṇaiḥ dhattūraka mūla cūrṇam viṣa ḍoḍikā cūrṇam halinī cūrṇam pratyekam pṛthak pṛthak saṃkṣiptvā āpya nikṣipya
abalā jana vaśa karaṇam madana kramukam samuddiṣṭam
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘kharaturagaśunīkṣīraiḥ’ rāsabhāśvaśunīkṣīraiḥ / ‘kramaśaḥ’ paripāṭyā / ‘paribhāvya’ bhāvyaṃ, kanakacūrṇaṃ kharadugdhena bhāvyaṃ, viṣamuṣṭicūrṇaṃ turagadugdhena bhāvyaṃ, halinīcūrṇaṃ śunīdugdhena bhāvyam iti krameṇa tatpūgīphalaṃ dinatrayeṇa bhāvanīyam, ‘yojayet khādye’ etat prakārasiddhaṃ kramukaṃ sakalaṃ tāmbūle yojanīyam /
analyzed: khara turaga śunī kṣīraiḥ rāsabha aśva śunī kṣīraiḥ kramaśas paripāṭyā paribhāvya bhāvyam kanaka cūrṇam khara dugdhena bhāvyam viṣamuṣṭi cūrṇam turaga dugdhena bhāvyam halinī cūrṇam śunī dugdhena bhāvyam iti krameṇa tat pūgī phalam dina trayeṇa bhāvanīyam yojayet khādye etat prakāra siddham kramukam sakalam tāmbūle yojanīyam

original: ‘abalājanavaśakaraṇaṃ madanakramukaṃ’ strījanānāṃ vaśīkaraṇaṃ anaṅgabāṇanāmadheyaṃ kramukam / ‘samuddiṣṭaṃ’ samyak kathitam //
analyzed: abalā jana vaśa karaṇam madana kramukam strī janānām vaśīkaraṇam anaṅgabāṇa nāmadheyam kramukam samuddiṣṭam samyak kathitam
gorocanā ahi kesara tagara rudantī ca karpūram
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘puttaṃjārī’ prasiddhā, ‘kuṅkumaṃ’ kāśmīram, ‘śarapuṅkhī’ śvetabāṇapuṅkhī, ‘mohanī’ vaṭapatrikā, ‘śamī’ keśahantrī, ‘kuṣṭaṃ’ koṣṭam / ‘gorocanā’ piṅgalā, ‘ahikesaraṃ’ nāgakesaram, ‘tagaraṃ’ piṇḍītagaram, ‘rudantī’ pratītā / ‘karpūraṃ’ candrānvitam //
analyzed: puttaṃjārī prasiddhā kuṅkumam kāśmīram śarapuṅkhī śvetabāṇapuṅkhī mohanī vaṭapatrikā śamī keśahantrī kuṣṭam koṣṭam gorocanā piṅgalā ahikesaram nāgakesaram tagaram piṇḍītagaram rudantī pratītā karpūram candra anvitam
kṛtvā eteṣām cūrṇam yāvaka madhye tatas parikṣipya
paṅkaja bhava tantu vṛtā vartiḥ kāryā punar tena
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘eteṣāṃ prāguktadravyāṇāṃ / ‘cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā’ cūrṇaṃ vidhāya / ‘yāvakamadhye tataḥ parikṣipya’ tadanantaraṃ tac cūrṇaṃ alaktakapaṭalamadhye nikṣipya / ‘paṅkajabhavatantuvṛtā’ padmanālikājanitasūtreṇa vṛtā / ‘vartiḥ kāryā’ anena prakāreṇa vartiḥ kartavyā / ‘punas tena’ paścāt tena vakṣyamāṇena //
analyzed: eteṣām prāc ukta dravyāṇām cūrṇam kṛtvā cūrṇam vidhāya yāvaka madhye tatas parikṣipya tad anantaram tat cūrṇam alaktaka paṭala madhye nikṣipya paṅkaja bhava tantu vṛtā padma nālikā janita sūtreṇa vṛtā vartiḥ kāryā anena prakāreṇa vartiḥ kartavyā punar tena paścāt tena vakṣyamāṇena
paribhāvya tatas kapilā ghṛtena paribodhayet dīpam
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘kārukikucabhavapayasā’ pañcakārukīstanodbhavadugdhena / ‘trivarṇayoṣāsrutastanakṣīraiḥ’ tataḥ kārukīkucabhavapayaso 'nantaraṃ brāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyastrīṇāṃ stanadugdhena / ‘paribhāvya’ prākkṛtavartiḥ tair dugdhair bhāvayitavyā / ‘tataḥ’ bhāvanānantaraṃ ‘kapilāghṛtena’ kapilājyena / ‘paribodhayet’ prajvālayet / kam? ‘dīpam’ //
analyzed: kārukī kuca bhava payasā pañca kārukī stana udbhava dugdhena tri varṇa yoṣā sruta stana kṣīraiḥ tatas kārukī kuca bhava payasaḥ nantaram brāhmaṇa kṣatriya vaiśya strīṇām stana dugdhena paribhāvya prāk kṛta vartiḥ taiḥ dugdhaiḥ bhāvayitavyā tatas bhāvanā anantaram kapilā ghṛtena kapila ājyena paribodhayet prajvālayet kam dīpam
ubhaya grahaṇe dīpa utsave ca nava karpare ñjanam dhāryam
gomaya vilipta bhūmyām sthitvā mantra abhiṣiktāyām
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘ubhayagrahaṇe’ somasūryagrahaṇe / ‘dīpotsave ca’ athavā dīpāvalīparvaṇi / ‘navakarpare 'ñjanaṃ dhāryam’ navīnamṛdbhāṇḍakapāle ‘añjanaṃ dhāryam’ kajjalaṃ grāhyam / ‘gomayaviliptabhūmyāṃ’ bhūmyapatitagomayena sammārjitapṛthivyām / ‘sthitvā’ uṣitvā / kathaṃbhūtāyām? ‘mantrābhiṣiktāyāṃ’ vakṣyamāṇamantreṇābhiṣiktabhūmyām //
analyzed: ubhaya grahaṇe soma sūrya grahaṇe dīpa utsave ca athavā dīpa āvalī parvaṇi nava karpare ñjanam dhāryam navīna mṛd bhāṇḍa kapāle añjanam dhāryam kajjalam grāhyam gomaya vilipta bhūmyām bhūmi a patita gomayena sammārjita pṛthivyām sthitvā uṣitvā kathaṃbhūtāyām mantra abhiṣiktāyām vakṣyamāṇa mantreṇa abhiṣikta bhūmyām

original: mantroddhāraḥ–––oṃ bhūr bhūmidevate tiṣṭha tiṣṭha ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ // bhūmisammārjanamantraḥ // oṃ namo bhagavate candraprabhāya candrendramahitāya nayanamanoharāya hariṇi hariṇi sarvaṃ vaśyaṃ kuru kuru svāhā // kajjaloddhāraṇamantraḥ // oṃ namo bhūtāya samāhitāya kāmāya rāmāya oṃ culu culu gulu gulu nīlabhramari nīlabhramari manohari namaḥ //
analyzed: mantra uddhāraḥ om bhūḥ bhūmi devate tiṣṭha tiṣṭha ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ bhūmi sammārjana mantraḥ om namaḥ bhagavate candraprabhāya candrendra mahitāya nayana manoharāya hariṇi hariṇi sarvam vaśyam kuru kuru svāhā kajjala uddhāraṇa mantraḥ om namaḥ bhūtāya samāhitāya kāmāya rāmāya om culu culu gulu gulu nīla bhramari nīla bhramari manohari namaḥ
nayana añjana mantraḥ
kajjala rañjita nayane dṛṣṭvā tām vāñchati iha madanaḥ pi

original: naram apy añjitanayanaṃ bhūpādyās tasya yānti vaśam || 9.19 ||
analyzed: naram api añjita nayanam bhūpa ādyāḥ tasya yānti vaśam
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘kajjalarañjitanayane’ kajjalenāñjite netre / ‘dṛṣṭvā’ vilokya / ‘tāṃ’ kāminīṃ ‘vāñchatīha madano 'pi’ kāmadevo 'pi vaśaṃ yāti / ‘naram apy añjitanayanaṃ dṛṣṭvā / ‘bhūpādyāḥ tasya yānti vaśaṃ’ tasya kajjalāñjitapuruṣasya kṣatriyādyās tadañjanād vaśyā bhavanti //
analyzed: kajjala rañjita nayane kajjalena añjite netre dṛṣṭvā vilokya tām kāminīm vāñchati iha madanaḥ pi kāmadevaḥ pi vaśam yāti naram api añjita nayanam dṛṣṭvā bhūpa ādyāḥ tasya yānti vaśam tasya kajjala añjita puruṣasya kṣatriya ādyāḥ tad añjanāt vaśyāḥ bhavanti
tad rasa bhāvita patram piśācayati udara madhya gatam
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘viṣamuṣṭiḥ’ viṣaḍoḍikā / ‘kanakamūlaṃ’ dhattūramūlam / ‘rālākṣatavāriṇā’ rālākṣatadhautodakena / ‘tataḥ piṣṭam’ tasmāt piṣṭam / ‘tadrasabhāvitapatraṃ’ tatpiṣṭauṣadharasena bhāvitaṃ tāmbūlapatram / ‘piśācayati’ piśāca ivācarati / ‘udaramadhyagataṃ’ jaṭharamadhyaṃ gate sati puruṣaṃ piśācayati //
analyzed: viṣamuṣṭiḥ viṣa ḍoḍikā kanaka mūlam dhattūra mūlam rāla akṣata vāriṇā rāla akṣata dhauta udakena tatas piṣṭam tasmāt piṣṭam tat rasa bhāvita patram tad piṣṭa auṣadha rasena bhāvitam tāmbūla patram piśācayati piśācaḥ iva ācarati udara madhya gatam jaṭhara madhyam gate sati puruṣam piśācayati
cikkaṇikā īpsitarūpā piśācikā sārdra cita maṣī mathite
nṛ kapāle mātṛ gṛhe kānana kārpāsa kṛta vartyā
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘cikkaṇikā’ iloṭhā, karṇāṭabhāṣāyāṃ uhāṭhā / ‘īpsitarūpā’ bahurūpā, saraṭaviṭ / ‘piśācikā’ kapikacchukā / ‘sārdracitamaṣīmathite’ sārdracitodbhavamaṣyā nirmathite / kasmin? ‘nṛkapāle’ narakapāle / ‘mātṛgṛhe’ saptamātṛkāṇāṃ gṛhe / ‘kānanakārpāsakṛtavartyā’ araṇyodbhavakārpāsatūlena nirmitavartyā //
analyzed: cikkaṇikā iloṭhā karṇāṭa bhāṣāyām uhāṭhā īpsitarūpā bahurūpā saraṭa viś piśācikā kapikacchukā sa ārdra cita maṣī mathite sa ārdra cita udbhava maṣyā nirmathite kasmin nṛ kapāle nara kapāle mātṛ gṛhe sapta mātṛkāṇām gṛhe kānana kārpāsa kṛta vartyā araṇya udbhava kārpāsa tūlena nirmita vartyā
dhāryam kṛṣṇa aṣṭamyām añjanam etat mahā ghṛta udbhūtam

original: tena triśūlam añjanam api kuryād aṅkabhīty artham || 9.22 ||
analyzed: tena triśūlam añjanam api kuryāt aṅka bhīti artham
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘dhāryam’ dhartavyam / ‘kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ’ kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ vā / kim? ‘añjanaṃ’ kajjalam / ‘etat’ etat kajjalam / ‘mahāghṛtodbhūtam’ mahāghṛtodbhavam / ‘tena triśūlaṃ kuryāt’ anena prakāreṇa kṛtakajjalena na kevalaṃ triśūlaṃ kuryāt / ‘añjanam api kuryāt’ nayanāñjanam api karotu /
analyzed: dhāryam dhartavyam kṛṣṇa aṣṭamyām kṛṣṇa aṣṭamyām kṛṣṇa caturdaśyām vā kim añjanam kajjalam etat etat kajjalam mahā ghṛta udbhūtam mahā ghṛta udbhavam tena triśūlam kuryāt anena prakāreṇa kṛta kajjalena na kevalam triśūlam kuryāt añjanam api kuryāt nayana añjanam api karotu

original: kim artham? ‘aṅkabhītyartham’ etad añjanaṃ pratipakṣakasya bhayotpādanārtham //
analyzed: kim artham aṅka bhīti artham etat añjanam pratipakṣakasya bhaya utpādana artham

original: tatkajjaloddhāramantraḥ–––oṃ namo bhagavati hiḍimbavāsini allallamāṃsappiye nahayalamaṃḍalapaïṭṭhie tuha raṇamatte paharaṇaduṭṭhe āyāsamaṃḍi pāyālamaṃḍi siddhamaṃḍi joiṇimaṃḍi savvamuhamaṃḍi kajjalaṃ paḍaü svāhā // prākṛtamantraḥ // kajjalapātanaṃ aiśānyabhimukhena kartavyam //
analyzed: tad kajjala uddhāra mantraḥ om namaḥ bhagavati hiḍimba vāsini allalla māṃsa ppiye tuha raṇa matte paharaṇa duṭṭhe āyāsa maṃḍi pāyāla maṃḍi siddha maṃḍi joiṇi maṃḍi savva muha maṃḍi kajjalam paḍañ svāhā prākṛta mantraḥ kajjala pātanam aiśānī abhimukhena kartavyam
cita vahni dagdha bhūtadruma yama śākhā maṣīm samāhṛtya
aṅkolla taila sūtaka kṛṣṇa biḍālī jarāyuḥ ca 923
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘citavahnidagdhabhūtadrumayamaśākhāmaṣīṃ’ citāgnijvalitakalidrumadakṣiṇadigbhavaśākhājanitamaṣīm / ‘samāhṛtya’ samyag āhṛtya / ‘aṅkollatailaṃ’ aṅkollabījodbhavatailaṃ / ‘sūtakam’ pāradarasam / ‘kṛṣṇabiḍālījarāyuś ca’ kṛṣṇamārjārījarāyum api //
analyzed: cita vahni dagdha bhūta druma yama śākhā maṣīm cita agni jvalita kali druma dakṣiṇa diś bhava śākhā janita maṣīm samāhṛtya samyak āhṛtya aṅkolla tailam aṅkolla bīja udbhava tailam sūtakam pārada rasam kṛṣṇa biḍālī jarāyuḥ ca kṛṣṇa mārjārī jarāyum api
ghūkanayana ambu mardita gulikām kṛtvā triloha sambhaṭhitām
dhṛtvā tām ātma mukhe puruṣaḥ dṛśya tvam āyāti
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘ghūkanayanāmbumarditagulikāṃ kṛtvā’ ulūkanetrāmbumarditabhūtadrumodbhavamaṣyādicaturdravyāṇāṃ guṭikāṃ kṛtvā / ‘trilohasammaṭhitāṃ’ tāmratārasuvarṇākhyaiḥ arkaṣoḍaśavahnibhir iti bhāgakṛtatrilohena samyag mathitāṃ kṛtvā / ‘dhṛtvā tām ātmamukhe’ tāṃ trilohamaṭhitāṃ gulikāṃ svamukhe dhārayitvā / ‘puruṣaḥ’ pumān / ‘adṛśyatvam’ adṛśyabhāvam /
analyzed: ghūka nayana ambu mardita gulikām kṛtvā ulūka netra ambu mardita bhūtadruma udbhava maṣi ādi catur dravyāṇām guṭikām kṛtvā triloha sammaṭhitām tāmra tāra suvarṇa ākhyaiḥ arka ṣoḍaśa vahnibhiḥ iti bhāga kṛta trilohena samyak mathitām kṛtvā dhṛtvā tām ātma mukhe tām triloha maṭhitām gulikām sva mukhe dhārayitvā puruṣaḥ pumān adṛśya tvam adṛśya bhāvam
āyāti āgacchati
sita śarapuṅkhā mūlam dhṛtvā sita kokilākṣa bījam ca
vana vasalā rasa piṣṭam vīrya stambham mukhe saṃstham
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘sitaśarapuṅkhāmūlaṃ’ śvetabāṇapuṅkhāmūlam / ‘dhṛtvā’ gṛhītvā / ‘sitakokilākṣabījaṃ ca’ śvetakokilākṣabījāni ca / ‘vanavasalārasapiṣṭam’ araṇyodbhava (u)podakīrasena peṣitaṃ vanavalā iti karṇāṭabhāṣāyāṃ kāsali / ‘vīryastambhaṃ’ śukrastambham / ‘mukhe saṃsthaṃ’ puruṣamukhe saṃstham //
analyzed: sita śarapuṅkhā mūlam śveta bāṇapuṅkhā mūlam dhṛtvā gṛhītvā sita kokilākṣa bījam ca śveta kokilākṣa bījāni ca vanavasalā rasa piṣṭam araṇyodbhavaḥ upodakī rasena peṣitam vanavalā iti karṇāṭa bhāṣāyām vīrya stambham śukra stambham mukhe saṃstham puruṣa mukhe saṃstham
kṛṣṇa vṛṣadaṃśa dakṣiṇa jaṅghāyāḥ śalya khaṇḍam ādāya
baddham kaṭi pradeśe vīrya stambham nṛṇām kurute
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘kṛṣṇavṛṣadaṃśadakṣiṇajaṅghāyāḥ’ kṛṣṇabiḍāladakṣiṇajaṅghāyāḥ / ‘śalyakhaṇḍaṃ’ tadasthikhaṇḍam / ‘ādāya’ gṛhītvā / ‘baddhaṃ kaṭipradeśe’ puṃsaḥ kaṭipradeśe baddham / ‘nṛṇāṃ’ manuṣyāṇām / vīryastambhaṃ ‘kurute’ karoti //
analyzed: kṛṣṇa vṛṣadaṃśa dakṣiṇa jaṅghāyāḥ kṛṣṇa biḍāla dakṣiṇa jaṅghāyāḥ śalya khaṇḍam tad asthi khaṇḍam ādāya gṛhītvā baddham kaṭi pradeśe puṃsaḥ kaṭi pradeśe baddham nṛṇām manuṣyāṇām vīrya stambham kurute karoti
stambhayati puruṣa vīryam rati ārambhe niśā samaye
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘kapilāghṛtena’ kapilājyena / ‘bodhitadīpaḥ’ prajvālitadīpaḥ / kathaṃbhūtaḥ? ‘suragopacūrṇasammilitaḥ’ indragopacūrṇagarbhakṛtavartyānvitaḥ / sa dīpaḥ kiṃ karotīty āha ‘stambhayati’ stambhaṃ karoti / kim? ‘puruṣavīryam’ nṛvīryam / kasmin? ‘ratyārambhe’ surataprārambhe / kva? ‘niśāsamaye’ rātrisamaye //
analyzed: kapilā ghṛtena kapila ājyena bodhita dīpaḥ prajvālita dīpaḥ kathaṃbhūtaḥ suragopa cūrṇa sammilitaḥ indragopa cūrṇa garbha kṛta vartyā anvitaḥ sa dīpaḥ kim karoti iti āha stambhayati stambham karoti kim puruṣa vīryam nṛ vīryam kasmin rati ārambhe surata prārambhe kva niśā samaye rātri samaye
ṭaṅkaṇa pippalikā māsūraṇa karpūra mātuliṅga rasaiḥ
kṛtvā ātma aṅguli lepam kurute strīṇām bhaga drāvam
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘ṭaṅkaṇaṃ’ mālatītaṭasambhavam / ‘pippalikāmā’ mahārāṣṭrī / ‘sūraṇa’ araṇyaśvetasūraṇakandaḥ / ‘karpūraḥ’ candraḥ / ‘mātuliṅgaṃ’ bījapūram / teṣāṃ rasaiḥ / ‘kṛtvā’ / kam? ‘ātmāṅgulilepaṃ’ svāṅgulilepam / ‘strīṇāṃ’ vanitānām / ‘bhagadrāvaṃ’ bhaganirjharaṇaṃ kurute //
analyzed: ṭaṅkaṇam mālatī taṭasambhavam pippalikā amā mahārāṣṭrī sūraṇa araṇya śveta sūraṇa kandaḥ karpūraḥ candraḥ mātuliṅgam bījapūram teṣām rasaiḥ kṛtvā kam ātma aṅguli lepam sva aṅguli lepam strīṇām vanitānām bhaga drāvam bhaga nirjharaṇam kurute
mūlam śvetāpamārgasya kubera diśi saṃsthitam
uttarā tritayam grāhyam śīrṣa stham dyūta vāda jit
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘mūlaṃ śvetāpamārgasya’ śvetakharamañjaryā mūlam / kathaṃbhūtam? ‘kuberadiśi saṃsthitam’ / ‘uttarātritaye’ uttarāphālgunī––uttarāṣāḍhā––uttarābhādrapadeti ṛkṣatraye / ‘grāhyaṃ’ gṛhītavyam / ‘śīrṣasthaṃ’ mastake sthitam / ‘dyūtavādajit’ dyūte vivāde vijayaṃ karoti //
analyzed: mūlam śveta apamārgasya śveta kharamañjaryāḥ mūlam kathaṃbhūtam kubera diśi saṃsthitam uttarā tritaye uttarā phālgunī uttarāṣāḍhā uttarā bhādrapada iti ṛkṣa traye grāhyam gṛhītavyam śīrṣa stham mastake sthitam dyūta vāda jit dyūte vivāde vijayam karoti
agni āvartita nāge haravīryam nikṣipet tatas dviguṇam
muni kanaka nāga sarpa jyotiṣmatī atasibhiḥ ca tat mardyam
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘agnyāvartitanāge’ agninā vartite nāge / ‘haravīryaṃ’ pāradarasam / ‘nikṣipet tato dviguṇaṃ’ tataḥ nāgaikabhāgād rasaṃ dvibhāgaṃ nikṣipet / ‘muniḥ’ raktāgastiḥ / ‘kanakaṃ’ kṛṣṇadhattūraṃ / ‘nāgasarpaḥ’ nāgadamanakaṃ / ‘jyotiṣmatyatasibhiś ca’ kaṃguṇyatasībhyāṃ ca / ‘tan mardyam’ tatpūrvoktanāgam eteṣāṃ rasair mardanīyam //
analyzed: agni āvartita nāge agninā vartite nāge haravīryam pārada rasam nikṣipet tatas dviguṇam tatas nāga eka bhāgāt rasam dvi bhāgam nikṣipet muniḥ rakta agastiḥ kanakam kṛṣṇadhattūram nāga sarpaḥ nāgadamanakam jyotiṣmatī atasibhiḥ ca kaṃguṇī atasībhyām ca tat mardyam tat pūrva ukta nāgam eteṣām rasaiḥ mardanīyam
ḍīkena mardayitvā gaṇiyā āryāḥ madanavalayakam kṛtvā
rati samaye vanitānām rati darpa vināśanam kuryāt
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘ḍīkena’ niryāsena / ‘mardayitvā’ punar api mardanaṃ kṛtvā / kasyāḥ ḍīkena? ‘gaṇiyāryāḥ’ karṇikāravṛkṣasya / ‘madanavalayakaṃ kṛtvā’ smaravalayaṃ liṅge kṛtvā / ‘ratisamaye’ suratakāle / ‘vanitānāṃ’ strīṇām / ‘ratidarpavināśanaṃ’ suratagarvavināśanam / ‘kuryāt’ karoti //
analyzed: ḍīkena niryāsena mardayitvā punar api mardanam kṛtvā kasyāḥ ḍīkena gaṇiyā āryāḥ karṇikāra vṛkṣasya madanavalayakam kṛtvā smaravalayam liṅge kṛtvā rati samaye surata kāle vanitānām strīṇām rati darpa vināśanam surata garva vināśanam kuryāt karoti
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘vyāghrībṛhatīphalarasaṃ’ bṛhatīdvayaphalarasaṃ / ‘sūraṇaṃ’ śvetasūraṇaṃ / ‘kaṇḍūtiḥ’ agnikaḥ / ‘caṇakapatrāmbu’ ārdracaṇakapatrāmbu / ‘kapikacchuḥ’ piśācikā / ‘vajravallī’ kāṇḍavallī / ‘pippalikāmā’ mahārāṣṭrī / ‘amlikā’ cāṅgerī / ‘cūrṇaṃ’ keṣāṃcid rasaḥ //
analyzed: vyāghrī bṛhatī phala rasam bṛhatī dvaya phala rasam sūraṇam śveta sūraṇam kaṇḍūtiḥ agnikaḥ caṇaka patra ambu ārdra caṇaka patra ambu kapikacchuḥ piśācikā vajravallī kāṇḍavallī pippalikā amā mahārāṣṭrī amlikā cāṅgerī cūrṇam keṣāṃcid rasaḥ
agni āvartita nāgam nava vāram bhāvayet imaiḥ dravyaiḥ
smara valayam kṛtvā evam vanitānām drāvaṇam kurute
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘agnyāvartitanāgaṃ’ / ‘navavāraṃ’ navasaṃkhyāvāraiḥ / ‘bhāvayed’ bhāvanāṃ kuryāt / kaiḥ? ‘imair dravyaiḥ’ etatkathitadravyaiḥ / ‘smaravalayaṃ kṛtvaivaṃ’ anena prakāreṇa madanavalayaṃ kṛtvā / ‘vanitānāṃ’ strīṇām / ‘drāvaṇaṃ’ bhaganirjharaṇaṃ / ‘kurute’ karoti //
analyzed: agni āvartita nāgam nava vāram nava saṃkhyā vāraiḥ bhāvayet bhāvanām kuryāt kaiḥ imaiḥ dravyaiḥ etad kathita dravyaiḥ smara valayam kṛtvā evam anena prakāreṇa madana valayam kṛtvā vanitānām strīṇām drāvaṇam bhaga nirjharaṇam kurute karoti
bhānu svara jina saṃkhyā pramāṇa sūtaka gṛhīta dīnārān
aṅkolla rājavṛkṣa kumārī rasa śodhanam kuryāt
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘bhānusvarajinasaṅkhyā’ dvādaśasaṅkhyā, ṣoḍaśasaṅkhyā, caturviṃśatisaṅkhyā / ‘pramāṇasūtakagṛhītadīnārān’ evaṃ trisaṅkhyākathitapramāṇapāradarasagṛhītagadyāṇakān / ‘aṅkollarājavṛkṣakumārīrasaśodhanaṃ kuryāt’ ‘aṅkollarasaḥ’ sampākarasaḥ / ‘rājavṛkṣarasaḥ’ / ‘kumārīrasaḥ’ gṛhakanyārasaḥ / etaiḥ rasaiḥ pāradasaṃśodhanaṃ kuryāt //
analyzed: bhānu svara jina saṅkhyā dvādaśa saṅkhyā ṣoḍaśa saṅkhyā caturviṃśati saṅkhyā pramāṇa sūtaka gṛhīta dīnārān evam tri saṅkhyā kathita pramāṇa pārada rasa gṛhīta gadyāṇakān aṅkolla rājavṛkṣa kumārī rasa śodhanam kuryāt aṅkolla rasaḥ sampāka rasaḥ rājavṛkṣa rasaḥ kumārī rasaḥ gṛhakanyā rasaḥ etaiḥ rasaiḥ pārada saṃśodhanam kuryāt
śaśirekhā kharakarṇī kokila nayana apamārga kanakānām

original: ‘śaśirekhā’ vākucībījaṃ / ‘kharakaṇī’ gardabhakarṇī, karṇāṭabhāṣayā kartyegiri / ‘kokilānayanaṃ,’ kokilākṣibījaṃ ca / ‘apāmārgaḥ’ pratyekapuṣpībījam / ‘kanakaṃ’ kṛṣṇadhattūrakam / ‘cūrṇaiḥ sahaikaviṃśatidināni’ ebhiḥ cūrṇaiḥ saha pratyekaṃ ekaviṃśatidināni / ‘parimardayet sūtaṃ’ śodhitapāradarasaṃ mardayet //

analyzed: bhavate tubhyam śiṣyāya asmābhiḥ dattaḥ mantraḥ yam prāk kathita mantraḥ kathaṃbhūtaḥ guru paramparā āyātaḥ guru pāramparyeṇa āgataḥ kim kṛtvā sākṣīkṛtya sākṣikam kṛtvā kān hutāśana ravi śaśi tārā ambara adri gaṇān agni arka candra nakṣatra ākāśa adri samūhān
bhavatā api na dātavyaḥ samyaktva vivarjitāya puruṣāya
kiṃtu guru deva samayiṣu bhaktimate guṇa sametāya
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘bhavatāpi’ tvayāpi / ‘na dātavyaḥ’ na deyaḥ / kasmai? ‘samyaktvavivarjitāya’ samyaktvavihīnāya / ‘puruṣāya’ narāya / ‘kiṃtu’ athavā / ‘gurudevasamayiṣu bhaktimate’ gurudevasamaye bhaktiyuktāya / ‘guṇasametāya’ sakalaguṇasaṃyuktāya evaṃguṇaviśiṣṭāya puruṣāya dātavyaḥ //
analyzed: bhavatā api tvayā api na dātavyaḥ na deyaḥ kasmai samyaktva vivarjitāya samyaktva vihīnāya puruṣāya narāya kiṃtu athavā guru deva samayiṣu bhaktimate guru deva samaye bhakti yuktāya guṇa sametāya sakala guṇa saṃyuktāya evaṃguṇa viśiṣṭāya puruṣāya dātavyaḥ

original: lobhād athavā snehād dāsyasi ced anyasamayabhaktāya |
analyzed: lobhāt athavā snehāt dāsyasi ced anya samaya bhaktāya
bāla strī gomuni vadha pāpam yat tat bhaviṣyati te
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘lobhāt’ arthābhilāṣāt / athavā ‘snehāt’ vyāmohāt / ‘dāsyasi cet’ yadi imāṃ vidyāṃ dāsyasi / kasmai? ‘anyasamayabhaktāya’ parasamayabhaktiyuktāya / tadā ‘bālastrīgomunivadhapāpaṃ yat’ bālakastrījanagomunijanahananena yat pāpam / ‘tadbhaviṣyati te’ tat pāpaṃ tava bhaviṣyati /
analyzed: lobhāt artha abhilāṣāt athavā snehāt vyāmohāt dāsyasi ced yadi imām vidyām dāsyasi kasmai anya samaya bhaktāya para samaya bhakti yuktāya tadā bāla strī go muni vadha pāpam yat bālaka strī jana go muni jana hananena yat pāpam tat bhaviṣyati te tat pāpam tava bhaviṣyati

original: ity evaṃ śrāvayitvā taṃ saṃnidhau gurudevayoḥ |
analyzed: iti evam śrāvayitvā tam saṃnidhau guru devayoḥ
mantrī samarpayet mantram mantra sādhana yogataḥ
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘taṃ’ mantragrāhakam / ‘ity evaṃ śrāvayitvā’ ity anena prakāreṇa śapathaṃ kārayitvā / kathaṃ? ‘saṃnidhau gurudevayoḥ’ gurudevayoḥ saṃnidhāne / ‘mantrī’ mantravādī / ‘samarpayet’ niyojayet / kam? ‘mantram’ gurupāramparyāgataṃ mantram / katham? ‘mantrasādhanayogataḥ’ mantrārādhanavidhānayogāt //
analyzed: tam mantra grāhakam iti evam śrāvayitvā iti anena prakāreṇa śapatham kārayitvā katham saṃnidhau guru devayoḥ guru devayoḥ saṃnidhāne mantrī mantra vādī samarpayet niyojayet kam mantram guru pāramparya āgatam mantram katham mantra sādhana yogataḥ mantra ārādhana vidhāna yogāt
praśastiḥ
sakala nṛpa mukuṭa ghaṭita caraṇa yugaḥ śrīmat ajitasena gaṇī
jayatu durita apahārī bhavya ogha bhava arṇava uttārī
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘sakalanṛpamukuṭaghaṭitacaraṇayugaḥ’ sakalabhūpālamukuṭaghaṭitapādāravindadvayaḥ / ‘śrīmadajitasenagaṇī’ śrīmadajitasenācāryaḥ / ‘jayatu’ sarvotkarṣeṇa vartatām / ‘duritāpahārī’ pāpāpahārī / punaḥ kathaṃbhūtaḥ? ‘bhavyaughabhavārṇavottārī’ bhavyajanasamūhasya saṃsārasamudrottārakaḥ /
analyzed: sakala nṛpa mukuṭa ghaṭita caraṇa yugaḥ sakala bhūpāla mukuṭa ghaṭita pāda aravinda dvayaḥ śrīmat ajitasena gaṇī śrīmat ajitasena ācāryaḥ jayatu sarva utkarṣeṇa vartatām durita apahārī pāpa apahārī punar kathaṃbhūtaḥ bhavya ogha bhava arṇava uttārī bhavya jana samūhasya saṃsāra samudra uttārakaḥ
karma indhana dahana paṭuḥ tad śiṣyaḥ kanakasena gaṇiḥ
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘jinasamayāgamavedī’ jineśvarasamayasakalāgamajñātā / ‘gurutarasaṃsārakānanocchedī’ durdharasaṃsṛtikāntāronmūlanasamarthaḥ / ‘karmendhanadahanapaṭuḥ’ sakalakarmendhanadahanakriyāyāṃ atīva dakṣaḥ / ‘tacchiṣyaḥ’ śrīmadajitasenācāryasya śiṣyaḥ / kaḥ? ‘kanakasenagaṇī’ kanakasenācāryaḥ //
analyzed: jina samaya āgama vedī jineśvara samaya sakala āgama jñātā gurutara saṃsāra kānana ucchedī durdhara saṃsṛti kāntāra unmūlana samarthaḥ karma indhana dahana paṭuḥ sakala karma indhana dahana kriyāyām atīva dakṣaḥ tad śiṣyaḥ śrīmat ajitasena ācāryasya śiṣyaḥ kaḥ kanakasena gaṇī kanakasena ācāryaḥ
tad śiṣyaḥ jinasenaḥ babhūva bhavya abja gharmāṃśuḥ
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘cāritrabhūṣitāṅgaḥ’ sakalacāritrabhūṣitaśarīraḥ / ‘niḥsaṅgaḥ’ bāhyābhyantaraparigraharahitaḥ / ‘mathitadurjayānaṅgaḥ’ durjayaś cāsau anaṅgaś ca durjayānaṅgaḥ mathito durjayānaṅgo yena sa mathitadurjayānaṅgaḥ nirjitamadanaḥ / ‘tacchiṣyaḥ’ kanakasenācāryasya śiṣyaḥ / kaḥ? ‘jinasenaḥ’ jinasenācāryaḥ / ‘babhūva’ saṃjātaḥ /
analyzed: cāritra bhūṣita aṅgaḥ sakala cāritra bhūṣita śarīraḥ niḥsaṅgaḥ bāhya abhyantara parigraha rahitaḥ mathita durjaya anaṅgaḥ durjayaḥ ca asau anaṅgaḥ ca durjaya anaṅgaḥ mathitaḥ durjaya anaṅgaḥ yena sa mathita durjaya anaṅgaḥ nirjita madanaḥ tad śiṣyaḥ kanakasena ācāryasya śiṣyaḥ kaḥ jinasenaḥ jinasena ācāryaḥ babhūva saṃjātaḥ
kathaṃbhūtaḥ bhavya abja gharmāṃśuḥ bhavya kamala prabodhana divākaraḥ
tadīya śiṣyaḥ malliṣeṇaḥ sarasvatī labdha vara prasādaḥ
tena uditaḥ bhairava devatāyā kalpaḥ samāsena catuḥśatena 1056
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘tadīyaśiṣyaḥ’ jinasenācāryasya śiṣyaḥ / ‘ajani’ jātaḥ / kaḥ? ‘malliṣeṇaḥ’ malliṣeṇācāryaḥ / kathaṃbhūtaḥ? ‘sarasvatīlabdhavaraprasādaḥ’ sarasvatīdevyāḥ sakāśāt prāptavaraprasādaḥ / ‘tena’ malliṣeṇācāryeṇa / ‘uditaḥ’ kathitaḥ / ‘bhairavadevatāyāḥ’ bhairavapadmāvatīdevyāḥ / ‘kalpaḥ’ mantravādasamūhaḥ / ‘samāsena’ saṃkṣepeṇa /
analyzed: tadīya śiṣyaḥ jinasena ācāryasya śiṣyaḥ ajani jātaḥ kaḥ malliṣeṇaḥ malliṣeṇa ācāryaḥ kathaṃbhūtaḥ sarasvatī labdha vara prasādaḥ sarasvatī devyāḥ sakāśāt prāpta vara prasādaḥ tena malliṣeṇa ācāryeṇa uditaḥ kathitaḥ bhairava devatāyāḥ bhairava padmāvatī devyāḥ kalpaḥ mantravāda samūhaḥ samāsena saṃkṣepeṇa
catuḥśatena catuḥśata saṃkhyā grantha pramāṇena
yāvat vārdhi mahīdhara tārā gaṇa gagana candra dinapatayaḥ
tiṣṭhanti tāvat āstām bhairava padmāvatī kalpaḥ 1057
Vivaraṇa

original: ‘yāvat’ yāvatkālaparyantam / ‘vārdhiḥ’ samudraḥ / ‘mahīdharaḥ’ kulaśailaḥ / ‘tārāgaṇaḥ’ nakṣatrasamūhaḥ / ‘gaganaṃ’ ākāśaḥ / ‘candraḥ’ mṛgāṅkaḥ / ‘dinapatiḥ’ mārtaṇḍaḥ / ete vārdhyādayo yāvatkālaparyantaṃ ‘tiṣṭhanti’ sthāsyanti / ‘tāvat’ tāvatkālaparyantam / ‘āstām’ tiṣṭhatu / ‘bhairavapadmāvatīkalpaḥ’ bhairavapadmāvatīnāmadevyāḥ mantrakalpaḥ //
analyzed: yāvat yāvat kāla paryantam vārdhiḥ samudraḥ mahīdharaḥ kula śailaḥ tārā gaṇaḥ nakṣatra samūhaḥ gaganam ākāśaḥ candraḥ mṛgāṅkaḥ dinapatiḥ mārtaṇḍaḥ ete vārdhya ādayaḥ yāvat kāla paryantam tiṣṭhanti sthāsyanti tāvat tāvat kāla paryantam āstām tiṣṭhatu bhairava padmāvatī kalpaḥ bhairava padmāvatī nāmadevyāḥ mantra kalpaḥ
iti ubhaya bhāṣā kavi śekhara śrī malliṣeṇa sūri viracitaḥ bhairavapadmāvatī kalpaḥ samāptaḥ
